本期的受邀嘉宾是美国Proctor Company有丰富经验的会计师Steven Yun先生和Annie Zheng女士，他们为大家专题分享《2019-2020 税务问题》。

两位嘉宾为大家提供专业的税务知识，着重分享了以下内容：新冠肺炎救济和经济援助法案/流行疾病失业补偿金2019年的税率和其他一些抵扣的数据/家庭办公室海外资产以及其他信息申报/Bitcoin（比特币)的纳税促进退休计划房地产出租后相关的折旧问题/房地产出租后相关的折旧问题

近四十位朋友出席了网络讲座，反应热烈。两位专业人士提供了精准的数据和实际案例的分享，并且当场解答了参会者提出的一些疑问， 参会人员受到了启发。 大家非常期待CCCWA今后继续举办各类专题讲座， 以便获得专业人士提供的最新业内信息。 同时, 大家肯定了CCCWA对服务社区的努力。

items.title_en: The "Caring Lunch" Press Conference Was Held Successfully, and Participants' Stories of Love Moved Seattle
items.title_zh: “爱心午餐”新闻发布会成功举行，参与者爱心故事感动西雅图
items.body_en:
Food with Love Promotion

Restaurants including The Dolar Shop, IJ Sushi Burrito and Yiheyuan Seafood Restaurant — the original initiators of this campaign — alongside delivery platform Chowbus, each shared touching stories behind their decision to join the Food with Love initiative.

The Dolar Shop: Spreading Kindness from Local Communities to Hospitals

Bruce, the person in charge, explained that The Dolar Shop was the very first restaurant to launch the complimentary meal service. After witnessing numerous police officers, security guards and delivery drivers left without access to meals amid the pandemic, the restaurant began handing out free lunches outside its storefront for anyone in need. Later, upon learning that medical workers faced far greater hardship, the restaurant expanded its meal donation coverage from local communities to hospitals.

IJ Sushi: We Will Keep Going Despite Doubts and Criticism

IJ Sushi: We Will Keep Going Despite Doubts

“When the pandemic hit, most of us stayed safely at home. Yet frontline workers could not isolate themselves; instead, they had to remain on duty for far longer hours, taking huge risks and bearing immense pressure every day. I kept thinking: these medical workers protect all of us, so what can we do to support them? I first shared the idea of delivering free meals to healthcare staff via WeChat. Unexpectedly, many people questioned our motives and doubted we would actually follow through. But now the Food with Love campaign is fully underway — not only have we delivered on our promise, we also stand side by side with numerous like-minded restaurants carrying out this mission together,” said Kevin, owner of IJ Sushi.

Yiheyuan Seafood Restaurant: Doors May Close, But Kindness Never Stops

A representative from Yiheyuan Seafood Restaurant shared that the restaurant group it belongs to operates forty-eight locations across China, all of which were forced to shut down amid the pandemic. Revenue plummeted drastically, yet the group still faced steep rent payments and staff payroll costs.

Even amid such severe financial hardship, the group’s owner made an unhesitating decision to provide free meals for Seattle’s medical workers upon learning local hospitals were in urgent need of support. Their generous contributions during this tough time stem from a deep sense of social accountability and moral duty.

Chowbus: Through Wind and Rain, We Always Deliver

Chowbus was among the first enterprises to join the Food with Love campaign, shouldering the critical delivery work for all donated meals. Michelle, Chowbus’s representative and lead of the campaign’s delivery team, shared, “I was deeply inspired by the restaurants’ selfless charity work, and I wanted to leverage our platform’s resources and strengths to help achieve this shared mission alongside everyone.”

The delivery operation faced numerous practical hurdles. First, hospitals enforced strict delivery standards, including precise drop-off times and mandatory food temperature requirements, meaning every meal had to arrive hot and fresh right on schedule. Second, as more restaurants joined the donation drive and the number of frontline medical recipients grew, the delivery workload expanded drastically. Every day, Chowbus couriers picked up meals from multiple restaurants before distributing them to a wide range of medical facilities, many far beyond regular delivery zones. At the time Michelle spoke, Chowbus drivers were out on a grueling route collecting food from four restaurants to deliver to eleven hospitals. The farthest facility was in Everett, a one-hour one-way drive alone. Despite all these obstacles, Chowbus fulfilled every single delivery commitment without fail.

To raise funds supporting the Food with Love program, Chowbus opened dedicated donation portals on its official website and mobile app. The platform raised over $3,000 in initial public donations. Leading by example, Michelle personally contributed an additional $500, and both sums were transferred to the campaign’s finance team to fund more complimentary meals for frontline workers. To date, Chowbus has delivered more than 2,000 charity meal boxes, and its fleet will continue transporting heartfelt meals to frontline responders throughout the rest of the campaign.

Beyond the restaurants featured at the press conference, three other eateries — Frying Fish, Rongcheng Old Hot Pot, and Liuyishou Hot Pot — also provided free meals to support medical staff on the pandemic frontlines.

Frying Fish: Doing Our Utmost to Share Our Love

Liuyishou Hot Pot: Delicious Dishes to Cheer Up Medical Workers

Financial & Legal Backing for the Campaign

This Food with Love initiative boasts solid legal and financial support. At the press conference, lead legal counsel Attorney Qing Cai stated: “A larger-scale campaign brings greater accountability. We aim to carry out this charity program smoothly while mitigating all potential risks. We conducted inspections of hygiene standards at all participating restaurants and drafted commitment letters to eliminate hidden hazards, allowing everyone to contribute their kindness without worry.”

Xiaoyan Li, the finance lead, shared an update on fundraising progress: “Our overall fundraising goal for this campaign is $400,000. So far, six partner restaurants have pledged a total of 14,150 meals valued at $242,000, out of which 4,145 meals worth $77,050 have already been delivered. During our press conference, Mr. Lai Huiwu, President of 505 Group, learned about our cause and donated $2,000 to show his support.”

Update: As of press time on the 16th, total cash donations received have reached $30,499.

Gratitude from Healthcare Workers

Medical Staff Express Their Thanks for the Food with Love Meals

Recipients among medical staff were deeply grateful for the donated meals and often expressed their appreciation to the campaign organizers in various ways. Some sent thank-you emails and text messages, while others posted photos of the meals on social media. Upon learning about the upcoming press conference, busy medical workers took time out of their packed schedules to record a short video with a heartfelt message: “Thank you all. We fight the pandemic on the front lines, and you stand firmly behind us to support us.”

Hospitals Receiving Food with Love Donations
Food with Love: We Welcome You to Join Us

The Food with Love Campaign: A Magnet Drawing Compassionate Hearts

This Food with Love initiative acts like a powerful magnet, attracting an ever-growing number of kindhearted participants and gaining support from partner community associations. Rhea, the volunteer in charge of all English communications, was moved to tears after learning the campaign’s touching story. She volunteered to manage all updates across the campaign’s Facebook, Twitter accounts and official English website.

The Seattle Entrepreneurship Club, another official partner of the program, was deeply touched by the initiative’s appeal and stepped forward to offer full support to the charity drive.

The press conference lasted just over an hour, yet the words “love” and “dedication” echoed throughout the whole event. While the entire community was weighed down by the hardships of the pandemic, this press conference served as a positive, heartwarming sharing session that brought comfort to everyone present. Inspired by these moving stories, we hope more people will join hands to do whatever we can to support our community and our beloved Seattle. We eagerly look forward to Seattle regaining its joy and liveliness soon.

“爱心午餐”宣传


关于餐厅为何参与到“爱心午餐”中，最先发起本次活动的餐厅豆捞坊、IJ Sushi、颐和园海鲜酒楼，以及送餐平台Chowbus分别分享了各自背后令人感动的故事。


豆捞坊：从社区到医院，爱心在扩大

负责人Bruce介绍，豆捞坊是最早一家开始送爱心午餐的餐厅，当看到疫情发生后很多警察、保安、司机没有吃饭的地方，他们便在饭店门口发放免费午餐，让这些需要帮助的人能随时获得。后来当得知医护人员更急需帮助后，他们的爱心午餐覆盖范围也从社区扩大到医院。


IJ Sushi：即使被质疑，也会做下去

“当疫情发生后，我们都安安全全待在家里，但一线人员不但不能待在家里，反而需要在工作岗位待命更长时间，他们需要顶着很大风险和压力去工作。我想，这些医护人员在守护我们，而我们又能为这些医护人员做些什么？一开始我先通过微信渠道发出想给医护人送免费餐的消息。没想到这个消息竟然收到质疑，很多人不相信我们会这么做。而现在爱心午餐活动的进行，不但证明我们做到了，而且还有很多志同道合的餐厅和我们一起在做！” IJ Sushi 老板Kevin说。


颐和园海鲜酒楼：

门店可以关  爱心不能断

颐和园海鲜酒楼负责人说，颐和园餐厅所在的集团在国内还有四十八家门店，因为受疫情影响都关闭了，不但营业额大幅下滑，还要支付不菲的房租和员工工资。然而在自身都受影响严重的情况下，当集团老板得知西雅图这边需要援助医院时候，还是义无反顾决定用爱心午餐支援医护人员。在艰难时刻还能慷慨解囊，是心中的一份责任与担当。


Chowubus:  风雨兼程 使命必达


作为担当爱心餐运输重任的Chowbus是最先参与到本次活动的企业之一，本次活动配送组组长、Chowbus负责人Michelle说，“能参加这个活动是被餐厅义举所感动，也想用自己资源和优势和大家一起实现这个目标。” 据了解Chowbus在送餐中确实遇到不少挑战：首先，医院对送餐标准有着严格的要求，比如送达时间、餐品温度等，要在规定时间将符合温度标准的食物送到。其次，随着捐助餐厅、受助医护人员的增多，让配送任务更为繁重。每天，Chowbus需要从不同餐厅出发送往不同医院，有的远远超出送餐范围。就在Michelle发言当时，Chowbus的司机正在赶在送餐的路上，要从4家餐厅取餐送到11个医院，而最远的一家医院在Everett，仅单程就需要1个小时车程。面对这些挑战，Chowbus都一一克服使命必达。为了给“爱心午餐”筹集捐款，Chowbus在网站和APP上也开通捐赠通道并将首批捐款3000多美元，除了这些捐款，Milchelle 自己也身体力行，率先捐款500美金，她已将这两笔捐款交给财务组。现在，Chowbus已经送出2000多份爱心盒饭，在接下来活动中还将继续带着爱心餐上路。


其实，除了参加新闻发布会的餐厅外，还有沸腾鱼乡、蓉城老火锅、刘一手这三家餐厅也都分别用爱心午餐来支援一线医务人员。


沸腾鱼乡：尽最大力  献一份爱


刘一手：用精美餐品给医护人员加油

财务和法律后盾


本次爱心午餐活动也有强大的律师和财务后盾。新闻发布会上，法律负责人蔡青律师说：“活动越大责任就越大，既要把爱心活动做好，又要把潜在风险降低。通过对加盟餐馆的卫生条件进行考察，并起草承诺函等，将潜在风险点一一排除，让大家更能踏踏实实献爱心。”财务负责人李晓艳也介绍了活动的捐赠情况：“本次活动目标筹款40万美金，截止目前为止，6家餐厅总捐赠14150份套餐的金额是24.2万美金，已经捐出的4145份餐食价值77050美金，就在新闻发布会进行中，得知消息的505集团总裁来辉武先生也捐款2000美金表示对活动的支持。”


更新：在16日发稿当日，目前已经收到现金捐赠30499美元。” 


来自医护人员的感谢

医护人员感谢“爱心午餐”


爱心午餐让受捐助的医护人员感激不尽，他们经常用自己不同的方式来表达对活动组织方的感激，有的发Email和短信来致谢，有的在社交媒体上分享自己的爱心午餐。当医护人员得知要召开这次新闻发布会时，他们特意在百忙之中制作了小视频说：“感谢你们，我们在前线抗疫，你们在背后守护我们。”

“爱心午餐”受捐医院


爱心午餐 期待你的加入


这场“爱心午餐”活动就像一块磁力极强的磁铁，吸引了越来越多有爱心的人加入，也得到兄弟协会的支援。负责英文文宣的志愿者Rhea了解了这个爱心故事后差点落泪并主动承担起本次活动Facebook、Twitter 、英文网页等所有更新工作。而西雅图创业协会作为本次活动的合作伙伴在看到爱心午餐倡议书被感动，也发挥一臂之力帮助本次活动。


短短一个多小时的发布会，听到最多的就是爱和奉献，当大家都在被疫情而困扰时，这个新闻发布会就像是一个正能量的故事分享会，让所有人都感到温暖。在为之动容之际，也希望能有更多人参与进来，齐心协力，尽我们所能，为社区和我们生活的地方贡献一份力量，期待西雅图早日恢复往昔的欢声笑语！

items.title_en: CCCWA "Weekly Star" Session 4: A Special Session on "2019–2020 Tax Issues"
items.title_zh: 第四期CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会 “每周一星“的做客嘉宾，为大家专题分享《2019-2020 税务问题》。
items.body_en:
**Main topics include:**

- The CARES Act (COVID-19 relief and economic assistance) / pandemic unemployment compensation
- 2019 tax rates and other deduction figures / home office
- Reporting of overseas assets and other information / taxation of Bitcoin
- Boosting retirement plans
- Depreciation issues related to renting out real estate Featured Speaker Annie Zheng holds bachelor's and master's degrees from Beijing Foreign Studies University, a bachelor's degree in accounting from the University of Washington, and a master's in tax law from Golden Gate University. She is a Washington State CPA and a member of the AICPA and WSCPA. Her areas of expertise are the tax issues of new immigrants—including reporting overseas assets, corporate accounts, and investment income—and the tax issues of foreigners investing in U.S. real estate, including ITIN applications. Annie is also an IRS-approved CAA (Certifying Acceptance Agent) and can certify passports for foreigners. Featured Speaker Mr. Steven Yun holds a bachelor's degree from the University of Hong Kong and a master's in accounting from the University of Washington, and is a Washington State CPA and a member of the AICPA and WSCPA. He is highly experienced in tax planning for companies, including startup, corporate structure, and choice of profit-distribution methods. With long-standing experience dealing with the IRS and state tax departments, he can help clients avoid risk in audits. CCCWA has arranged these two tax experts' lectures in the hope of helping everyone in their work and life in the United States.

items.summary_en: The guest for the 3rd episode of 'Star of the Week' was CCCWA Chief Legal Counsel Attorney Lani Cao.
items.summary_zh: ​ 第三期“每周一星“的做客嘉宾是CCCWA法律总顾问曹霄鹤律师。
items.body_en:
The guest for the 3rd episode of 'Star of the Week' was CCCWA Chief Legal Counsel Attorney Lani Cao.

Attorney Cao first introduced the types of visas available to multinational companies in the US and their applicability, including: investment immigration (EB-5), extraordinary ability immigration (EB-1A), entrepreneur visas and green cards (L-1/L-2, EB-1C), employment-based immigration (EB-1/EB-2/EB-3), E1/E2 visas for nationals of New Zealand, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and other countries/regions, and TN visas for Canada and Mexico. She also addressed recent policy changes affecting green cards, noting that the global pandemic outbreak has affected USCIS processing timelines, and green card form submissions should closely follow USCIS announcements. Attorney Cao's law office will continue tracking the latest USCIS updates to help keep everyone informed!

Drawing on her rich work experience and real case studies, Attorney Cao promptly answered attendees' questions. CCCWA will continue to host similar special lectures in the future to obtain the latest industry information from professionals. CCCWA provides a win-win platform for exchange, sharing, and cooperation.
items.body_zh:
第三期“每周一星“的做客嘉宾是CCCWA法律总顾问曹霄鹤律师。

曹律师首先向大家介绍跨国公司在美国可以使用的签证种类和适用性，包括了：投资移民投资移民EB-5，特殊人才移民Eb-1A，企业家签证及绿卡L-1/L-2， Eb-1C，职业移民EB-1/ EB-2/ EB-3，新西兰，台湾，香港等国家或地区人士的 E1/E2, 加拿大，墨西哥的 TN 另外针对绿卡近期政策变化，曹律师强调全球这次疫情爆发，当下移民局的工作进程收到影响，绿卡的表格提交需要密切关注移民局公告。曹律师事务所会及时追踪移民局的最新动态，以便帮助大家了解更新的信息！

专业人士结合丰富的工作经历和实际案例的分享，及时解答了参会者提出的一些疑问， CCCWA今后继续举办各类专题讲座， 以便获得专业人士提供的最新业内信息。CCCWA是为大家提供交流、分享、合作的共赢平台。

items.title_en: We Invite You to Hear the Stories Behind the Caring Campaign — You're Cordially Invited to the 'Caring Lunch' Press Conference
items.title_zh: 邀请您聆听爱心活动背后的故事——“爱心午餐”新闻发布会诚邀您的参加
items.body_en:
As April had just begun, a "CCCWA Anti-Pandemic Caring Lunch Fundraising Proposal" spread throughout the social-media circles of Seattle's Chinese community, with people eagerly sharing it—not only praising the organizers' compassion, but also applauding this ingenious way of giving. The campaign was initiated by the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State (CCCWA), with lead donations from local Seattle restaurants and the delivery platform Chowbus, and enthusiastic support from all sectors of society. The campaign plans to raise $400,000 worth of caring lunches within one month to deliver into the hands of medical staff at healthcare institutions, community service workers, and community members in need. As of April 11, six main donor restaurants had pledged to jointly donate meal sets worth a total of $242,000, and $27,000 had been raised in donations from all sectors of society. After donating masks, protective suits, and other medical supplies to healthcare institutions, why participate in pandemic relief again in the form of "caring lunches"? The organizer, CCCWA, hopes to leverage the association's own strengths and use its unique methods and resources to support medical staff. "Right now, every member of the community is serving the frontline medical staff in their own way and cheering on our city. As a nonprofit organization formed spontaneously by Chinese-invested enterprises in Washington State, CCCWA has a group of outstanding and caring restaurant entrepreneurs. When they learned that the pandemic had made medical staff's work busier and more stressful, it became their wish to make sure frontline medical staff could eat a tasty lunch on time. Although the pandemic has hit their businesses hard, they still wanted to give generously, to support frontline medical staff, and to make their own contribution to the city they love. So we connected restaurant resources and, together with the delivery platform Chowbus, organized this caring-lunch campaign. We hope to unite the strength of all sectors of society, raise more funds, and together magnify their compassion," said CCCWA President Lily Lyu, explaining the origins of the campaign. The "caring lunch" received strong support from local Seattle restaurants and delivery platforms. The participating restaurants are all well-known names in the Seattle area: The Dolar Shop Chinese restaurant (together with Asian Family Market), IJ Sushi Burrito Japanese restaurant, Liuyishou Hot Pot, Frying Fish, Imperial Garden (Beijing Roast Duck), and Chengdu Memory Hot Pot. Due to the pandemic, the pause in the restaurant industry dealt a huge blow to business, but these restaurant owners "worried not about themselves but about the world." Rather than putting their own profits first, they selflessly devoted themselves to making free lunches. For delivery, the Chowbus delivery platform, with its professional delivery service, took the initiative to handle delivery for this caring campaign. Even though the pandemic was Chowbus's busiest period, Chowbus still assigned dedicated staff to coordinate scheduling and delivery, getting caring lunches into medical staff's hands on time every day. In the two weeks since the campaign began, nonprofit organizations including the Seattle Entrepreneurship Club, the Seattle Chinese New Immigrants Center, the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club, the Sunshine Youth Foundation, and the Guangfu Association have all given strong support and assistance. In particular, Attorney Cai Qing of Cai & Cai Law Firm, Ms. Sylvia Chin, Li Ruoyao and Zhang Shuo of Jing Wei LLC, and UW student Rhea not only led the way in donating funds in the project's early stages but also spent a great deal of time making outstanding contributions to advancing the project. A working group of some thirty-odd volunteers served this campaign, coming from various nonprofit organizations, donor units, communities, government, universities, and high schools. As of April 11, 3,845 caring lunches had been delivered, and 675 medical workers at 15 key anti-pandemic hospitals such as UW Virology, Swedish Hospital, Overlake Hospital, and Evergreen Hospital had enjoyed these caring lunches. The delivery scope will expand further, reaching more medical staff at healthcare institutions, community service workers, and community members in need. The medical workers also expressed heartfelt thanks for the campaign. Many were deeply grateful after receiving caring lunches, sharing them on social media, thanking the "caring lunch" in their own unique ways, and tagging these caring restaurants to "advertise" for them. April is a fragrant month, and this should be the most beautiful season—yet everyone involved in the "caring lunch" had no time to enjoy the spring scenery. They were busier every day, devoting their own efforts to fighting the pandemic. Now, to help everyone understand the "caring lunch" plan more fully, hear these restaurant entrepreneurs' original intentions for participating, and learn how the delivery platform Chowbus manages to promptly connect restaurants with hospitals, CCCWA will hold an online press conference on April 13 from 2:00PM to 3:30PM Seattle time. At that time, the restaurant owners, co-organizer leaders, and working-group members will share the stories behind this "caring lunch" with everyone. If you are a Chinese-language media outlet, independent media creator, or an interested partner organization or individual in Seattle, you are cordially invited to attend this online sharing event. **Press Conference Time: April 13, 2:00PM-3:30PM** **Zoom webcast link: https://washington.zoom.us/j/766492115** **Press Conference Agenda:** 1. CCCWA President Lily Lyu introduces an overview of the campaign 2. Remarks by Bellevue City Councilmember Conrad Lee 3. Remarks by three lead donor restaurant representatives (The Dolar Shop, IJ Sushi, Imperial Garden) 4. Attorney Cai Qing introduces the project's legal matters 5. Liaison group leader Sylvia introduces the recipient hospitals 6. Delivery group leader Michelle introduces delivery 7. Finance group leader Xiaoyan introduces donated supplies and funds 8. Publicity group leader Grace speaks, and English-media lead Rhea speaks 9. Fundraising group leader Na Jiyuan speaks 10. Remarks by co-organizing institutions 11. Interactive Q&A session **Supporting Organizations for This Event:** The Dolar Shop; Asian Family Market; Imperial Garden (Beijing Roast Duck); Chengdu Memory Hot Pot; Frying Fish; Liuyishou Hot Pot; Seattle Entrepreneurship Club; Seattle Chinese New Immigrants Center; Sunshine Youth Culture and Education Development Association; Seattle Real Estate Investment Club; Jing Wei LLC; SC Intl Realty (206-228-9404); Cai & Cai Associates; Create World America Real Estate Inc.; Pacific Sunrise International Corp. 四月刚刚开始拉开序幕，一则“CCCWA抗击疫情爱心午餐募捐倡议书”传遍了西雅图华人的朋友圈，大家竞相转发，不但为活动主办方的爱心点赞，更是为这个独出心裁的献爱心方式叫好。该活动由华盛顿州中国总商会（简称：CCCWA）发起倡议、西雅图本地餐厅与外送平台Chowbus参与领捐，并由社会各界热情支持。活动计划在一个月内募集价值40万美元的爱心午餐送到医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的社区成员手中。截止4月11日，6家主捐餐厅承诺将共同捐赠总价值$24.2万美金的套餐，募集到社会各界捐款2.7万美元。在向医疗机构捐赠口罩、防护服等医疗物资之后，为何又以“爱心午餐”形式参与到援助抗疫中？活动主办方CCCWA希望，发挥协会自身优势，用自己独特的方式和资源去支援医护人员。“现在社区的每一份子都用各自方式为抗疫前线的医护人员服务，为我们的城市加油。而CCCWA作为由华盛顿州中资企业自发组成的非营利性组织，拥有一批优秀而有爱的餐饮企业家，他们得知疫情让医护人员工作节奏更忙碌紧张，能让一线医护人员及时吃到可口的午餐成为他们的一个愿望，虽然疫情使他们的生意备受冲击，他们仍希望慷慨解囊，为一线医护人员助力，为自己热爱的城市做一点自己的贡献。于是我们对接餐厅资源，并联合外送平台Chowbus，一起组织了这次爱心午餐活动。我们希望联合社会各界力量，募集更多的资金，共同把他们的爱心放大。”CCCWA会长吕莉莉介绍本次活动发起缘由。“爱心午餐”得到西雅图当地餐厅和外送平台的大力支持。参与活动的餐厅都是西雅图地区耳熟能详的知名餐厅：豆捞坊中餐厅（联手百家超市）、IJ SushiBurrito日餐厅、刘一手火锅、沸腾鱼乡、颐和园北京烤鸭店、蓉城老火锅。由于受疫情影响，餐饮业暂停让餐饮业绩受到巨大冲击，但是这些餐馆负责人“不忧己而忧天下”，不但没把自身营利放在首位，反而无私奉献积极参与制作免费午餐。在配送上，拥有专业配送服务的Chowbus外卖平台主动承担起本次爱心活动的配送。尽管疫情期间正是Chowbus业务最为繁忙阶段，但是Chowbus依然配备了专门人员对接本次活动负责沟通排期与外送，每天准点将爱心午餐送到医护人员手中。活动开展两周来，西创会、西雅图新移民之家、西雅图地产投资俱乐部、阳光青少年基金会、广府会等非营利组织均对活动给予大力支持与协助，尤其是蔡和蔡律师事务所的蔡清律师、SylviaChin女士、美国经纬有限公司李若垚、张硕夫妇女士、华大在校生Rhea，他们在项目前期不仅带头捐赠资金，还花费了大量时间为项目的推进做出杰出贡献，一共有三十几个志愿者组成的工作小组在为这个活动服务，他们来自各个非营利组织、捐赠单位、社区、政府、大学、高中……

截至4月11日，爱心午餐已送出3845份，UW Virology、SwedishHospital、OverlakeHospital、EvergreenHospital等15家重点抗疫医院的675位医护工作者们已经享用到了这些爱心午餐。送餐范围还将扩大，活动还将普及到更多医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的社区成员。医护工作者们对本次活动也表示了由衷感谢。很多医护人员收到爱心午餐后都感激不尽，纷纷在社交媒体上分享自己的爱心午餐，用自己独特的方式致谢“爱心午餐”，并纷纷@这些爱心餐厅给他们“打广告”。人间芳菲四月天，这个本应是最美的季节，参与“爱心午餐”的所有人却无暇欣赏大美春光，他们每天更为忙碌，为抗击疫情而奉献一己之力。现在为了使大家更全面了解“爱心午餐”的规划，聆听这些餐饮企业参与本次活动的初心，以及外送平台Chowbus如何做到及时连接餐厅与医院的，CCCWA将于4月13日西雅图时间2:00PM至3:30PM举行线上新闻发布会。届时，各餐厅负责人、协办机构负责人、工作组成员，将和大家分享这次“爱心午餐”背后的故事。如果您是西雅图的中文媒体、自媒体人以及有意向的合作单位或个人，诚邀您参加本次线上分享活动。**发布会时间：4月13日2：00PM-3：30PM** **Zoom 网络直播链接:https://washington.zoom.us/j/766492115** **发布会流程：** 1．主办单位CCCWA会长吕莉莉介绍活动概况 2． Bellevue市议员李瑞麟先生发言 3． 三位领捐餐厅代表发言（豆捞坊、IJ sushi 、颐和园）4，蔡清律师介绍项目的法律事务 5， 联络组组长Sylvia介绍受捐医院情况 6， 配送组组长Michelle介绍配送情况 7，财务组组长Xiaoyan介绍捐物资及资金情况 8， 文宣组组长Grace 发言、英文媒体负责人Rhea发言 9， 募捐组组长那济源发言10，协办机构发言 11． 互动问答环节**本次活动支持单位：** 豆捞坊 THE DOLAR SHOP百家超市 (ASIAN FAMILY MARKET)IJ SUSHI BURRITO（kevin100118@gmail.com）Chowbus Inc.颐和园北京烤鸭店 （Imperial Garden）蓉城老火锅 （CHENGDU MEMORY)沸腾渔乡 (FRYING FISH)刘一手 （LIUYISHOU HOT POT) 西雅图创业协会（Seattle Entrepreneurship Club)西雅图移民之家（Seattle Chinese New immigrants Center）阳光青少年教育发展基金会（Sunshine YouthCulture and Education Development Association ）西雅图地产投资俱乐部（Seattle Real EstateInvestment Club ）Issaquah Highlands Chinese Heritage Club美国经纬有限公司（Jing Wei LLC）SC Intl Realty （2062289404）蔡和蔡律师事务所（ Cai & Cai Associates）拓宏美国（Create WorldAmerica Real Estate Inc.)太平洋日升国际公司 (Pacific Sunrise International Corp)

items.title_en: CCCWA Foundation Joins All Sectors of Society in Actively Fighting the Pandemic
items.title_zh: 华盛顿州中国总商会基金会联合社会各界积极抗疫
items.body_en:
English Translation

Since the donation portal of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State Foundation (hereinafter referred to as CCCWA Foundation) launched on March 20, the foundation has formed a task force together with the Xiamen University Alumni Association in Seattle, Zhejiang University North America Seattle Alumni Chapter and member enterprises of the Chamber. Within just one week, the team raised nearly $39,000 in cash donations from all walks of life, alongside supplies valued at almost $100,000. On the very launch day of the donation drive, medical supplies donated by Systimmune Inc. were delivered to Everett Providence Hospital and Overlake Medical Center.

The entire fundraising campaign gathered countless acts of kindness time and again, demonstrating unprecedented unity within the Chinese-American community. As soon as the fundraising appeal was released, nearly a hundred people joined the official CCCWA Foundation donation group. Meanwhile, the Xiamen University and Zhejiang University Seattle alumni chapters mobilized their respective alumni networks to raise funds, bringing the total number of participants to over 300.

Donors spanned a wide spectrum: Chinese-funded enterprises based in Seattle, renowned entrepreneurs, local government officials, industry professionals, as well as numerous local organizations and compassionate individual residents. Many individuals and businesses had already made multiple prior donations yet chose to contribute once more. All participants shared one unified mission: stand united to fight COVID-19 and safeguard our community.

At a time when courier services faced massive backlogs and international shipping routes were severely disrupted, the CCCWA Foundation task force raced against the clock to coordinate with all relevant parties, strictly verifying the quality and safety of all medical supplies. With support from professional foreign trade partners, the team expedited shipments to Seattle as rapidly as possible. To date, CCCWA Foundation has delivered donations to 14 facilities, distributing 82,000 face masks and 1,500 sets of personal protective equipment (including medical gloves, disposable coveralls and goggles). Large batches of additional supplies remain in transit. All recipient institutions expressed sincere gratitude and recognition for the donations. The inspiring image of the united Chinese community struck a chord with the broader public, and the campaign was featured by mainstream local media including KIRO 7 TV.

On March 27, the task force delivered supplies to Issaquah Swedish Hospital, where hospital staff distributed the gear directly to medical teams working in the ICU. Frontline medical workers described the donations as a much-needed lifeline amid crisis, and thanked the Chinese community for their care and support.

On March 31, representatives from the CCCWA Foundation team delivered donations to Virginia Mason Medical Center, Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center, as well as the Bellevue Police Department and Bellevue Fire Department. Gary Kaplan, CEO of Virginia Mason Medical Center, sent a personal letter to express his gratitude to the CCCWA Foundation.

From April 1 to 3, representatives of the CCCWA Foundation team rushed nonstop to deliver donations to UW Valley Medical Center, Evergreen Hospital, Overlake Medical Center, ICHS International District Medical and Dental Clinic in the International District, and Highline Medical Center in Burien.

Burien Mayor Jimmy Matta personally sent a letter to express gratitude to the CCCWA Foundation, writing emotionally: “As COVID-19 ravaged our community, your support gave us a glimmer of light at the end of the tunnel. Our entire community is thankful for you.”

As the pandemic situation in Washington State gradually stabilizes, this positive outcome stems not only from the selfless dedication of medical workers and cooperation from all sectors of society, but also from the unified dedication and support of the entire Chinese-American community. Many of us are first-generation immigrants. We pool strengths from our homeland to support our current home, for we hold this land deep in our hearts. Many a little makes a mickle; small acts of kindness combine to lift up our community. The CCCWA Foundation will continue to unite people from all walks of life to carry out donation efforts until victory is declared in the fight against the pandemic!

(Report with texts and photos: Carrie Wang, CCCWA Foundation)

华盛顿州中国总商会基金会（以下称CCCWA Foundation）捐赠通道自3月20日启动以来，联合厦门大学西雅图校友会（Xiamen University Alumni Association in Seattle）、浙江大学北美西雅图校友会（Zhejiang University North America Seattle Alumni）、总商会会员单位组成工作组，在短短一周内共筹集来自社会各界的资金捐赠近3万9千美金以及价值近10万美金的物资，并在通道启动当天将百利药业（SystimmuneInc）捐赠的物资送达Everett Providence Hospital及Overlake Medical Center.


整个筹款过程一次又一次凝聚了数万的爱心，见证了华人空前的团结。倡议书一经发出就号召聚集了百人加入CCCWA Foundation捐赠群，同时厦门大学西雅图校友会及浙江大学北美西雅图校友会分别在其校友群中进行号召和筹款，总参与人数超过300人。


此次捐赠者中不仅有西雅图地区的中资企业、知名企业家、政要、来自各行各业的精英，还有众多本地机构、组织和爱心人士，其中许多个人和单位已经几度捐款，但依旧再次献出爱心；所有的努力都因为我们有着共同的目标和心愿：团结一心、抗击新冠、保护社区！


在快递爆仓，航路不畅的特殊时期，CCCWA Foundation工作组争分夺秒对接各单位，确保物资的质量及安全性。并在专业外贸公司的协助下尽可能以最高的速度送达西雅图地区。截至日前，CCCWA Foundation共前往14家机构，捐出8万2千个口罩及1500套防护物资（含医用手套、防护服及护目镜）, 仍有大批物品还在运送途中。捐赠得到了受赠单位由衷的感谢和肯定，华人众志成城的形象深入人心，并被主流媒体：如KIRO 7电视频道报道。


3月27日工作组将物资送达Issaquah Swedish Hospital, 并由医院工作人员直接送至ICU的医护手中。医护人员都称这真是雪中送炭，感谢来自中国社区的关爱和保护。

3月31日CCCWA Foundation工作组代表前往Virginia Mason Medical Center、Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center及Bellevue市警察局、消防局进行捐赠。Virginia Mason的CEO Gary Kaplan特别发信致谢CCCAW Foundation。 4月1日至3日，CCCWA Foundation工作组代表马不停蹄前往UW Valley Medical Center、Evergreen Hospital、Overlake Medical Center、中国城ICHS International District Medical and Dental Clinic、Burien Highline Medial Center进行捐赠。Burien市长Jimmy Matta亲自致信感谢CCCWA Foundation，并动情地写到：“在新冠病毒COVID-19肆虐我们社区的时候，你们的帮助让我们看到了隧道尽头的希望之光。我们整个社区都感谢你们。”

目前华盛顿州疫情趋于稳定，这不仅因为医生们奋不顾身的努力和社会各界的配合，更因为有整个华人社区一致的奉献与支持。我们中许多人是第一代移民，我们汇聚来自母国的力量共同支援现在的家园，因为我们深爱这片土地。滴水汇江河，绵力助社区。CCCWA Foundation将继续团结社会各界进行捐赠，直到抗疫之战吹响胜利的号角！

items.title_zh: 抗击疫情，爱心餐募捐活动更新报道
items.body_en: CCCWA CCCWA _April 11, 2020 13:07_ The "Anti-Pandemic Caring Meal Fundraising Campaign"—initiated by the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State (CCCWA), with lead donations from The Dolar Shop Chinese restaurant, IJ Sushi Burrito Japanese restaurant, Imperial Garden, Chengdu Memory Hot Pot, Frying Fish, Liuyishou, and others—has received an enthusiastic response from Seattle's restaurant community. Together they pledged to provide meals worth a total of $242,250, about 14,150 nutritious meal sets, to express thanks and respect to the medical staff fighting on the pandemic's front lines! As of the evening of April 7, the participating restaurants, though their businesses were hit by the pandemic, still generously did their best to contribute to society. With their own funds and manpower, they had prepared 2,535 caring lunches (totaling $45,525) and delivered them into the hands of medical staff at healthcare institutions, community service workers, and community members in need. The "caring lunch" campaign is proceeding vigorously and in an orderly manner. It has also received enthusiastic support from all sectors of society, with donations growing by the day. CCCWA has received $26,479 in cash donations from caring individuals across the community, and everyone hopes to donate more caring meals through our platform. With the virus upon us, frontline medical workers choose to fight day and night to protect our health; we too should do our small part and offer a token of gratitude to these hardworking medical workers! Now, frontline medical staff fighting the pandemic at UW Virology, Swedish Hospital, Overlake Hospital, and Evergreen Hospital have enjoyed caring lunches. Many were deeply grateful after receiving them and **expressed their thanks to CCCWA and the sponsoring restaurants through social media!** UW Virology medical staff said on Facebook: **"These caring lunches are simply delicious."** The "caring lunch" campaign will reach more medical staff at healthcare institutions, community service workers, and community members in need. Freshly cooked, nutritious caring meal sets have drawn us closer to medical and community service workers—we all share the same love and gratitude. The Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State calls on more restaurants to join, and on more institutions, companies, and individuals to join, to help more medical staff and community members in need. Our fundraising campaign is completely open and transparent, strictly complies with U.S. law, and operates strictly according to nonprofit financial regulations; donation amounts and donated food will be published in real time. **Let's all take action! Love is not measured by size, nor by amount—let us use concrete action to express the courage and responsibility of our people of all ethnicities to fight the pandemic together and share the burden together!** **Supporting Organizations for This Event:** Asian Family Market; Imperial Garden; Chengdu Memory Hot Pot; Flying Fish; Liuyishou Hot Pot; Seattle Entrepreneurship Club; Seattle Chinese New Immigrants Center; Sunshine Youth Culture and Education Development Association; Seattle Real Estate Investment Club; Jing Wei LLC; Cai & Cai Associates; Pacific Sunrise International Corp. Donation receiving account: Please mail checks to: 325 118th AVE SE #100, Bellevue, WA 98005 (Attn: Xiaoyan Li). Bank account transfer: Cathay Bank. To donate directly, click: gf.me/u/xruzbv (please click from the server). If donating through your company's internal donation website, please search for Sunshine Youth Culture and Education Development Association. ***Donors, please be sure to note your name, address, email, and contact phone number so we can promptly provide your tax-deductible donation receipt.*** The Dolar Shop (Bruce.zixuan.lin@thedolarshop.com); IJ Sushi Burrito (kevin100118@gmail.com); Chowbus Inc.; Issaquah Highlands Chinese Heritage Club; SC Intl Realty (206-228-9404); Create World America Real Estate Inc. CCCWA CCCWA 

由华盛顿州中国总商会CCCWA发起倡议，豆捞坊中餐厅、IJ Sushi Burrito日餐厅、颐和园、蓉城老火锅、沸腾⻥乡、刘一手等领捐的“抗击疫情爱心餐募捐活动” 得到了⻄雅图餐饮界的热烈响应，他们共同承诺提供总价值$242,250美金，约14,150份营养套餐，以表达对奋战在抗疫前线的医护人员的感谢和敬意！

截至4月7日晚， 参与爱心活动的几家餐厅在生意受到疫情打击下，依然慷慨尽力 为社会做贡献。他们 出资金、安排人力已制作完成2,535份爱心午餐(合计$4,5525美金）并送到医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的 社区成员手中。

“爱心午餐”活动开展得如火如荼并且有条不紊地进行着。活动也得到社会各界的热情支持，爱心捐款数目与日俱增。 CCCWA已经收到了各界热心人士的现金捐赠美金$26,479，大家希望通过我们的平台捐赠更多的爱心餐。 病毒当前，前线的医务人员选择日夜奋战，全力保护着我们的健康，我们也当进绵薄之力，为辛苦的医务人员捐上一份感激之心!

现在，UW Virology、Swedish Hospital、Overlake Hospital 、Evergreen Hospital医院里奋战在抗疫一线的医护人员们已经享用到爱心午餐。很多医护人员收到爱心午餐后都感激不尽， **通过自媒体发表了他们对CCCWA和赞助餐厅的感谢心声！** UW Virology的医护人员在Facebook上说： **“这些爱心午餐简直太美味了“**。“爱心午餐”活动还将普及到更多医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的社区成员手里。 新鲜烹制的爱心 营养套餐将我们和医疗人员、社区服务人员拉近了距离，我们都有同样的爱心和感恩之情。

华盛顿州中国总商会倡议更多的餐饮企业加入进来，倡议更多的机构、公司和个人加入进来，为更多的医护人员和社区里需要救助的群体提供帮助。我们的募捐活动完全公开透明，严格遵守美国法律，且严格按照非营利机构的财务规定运作，捐款数目和捐助食品都将实时公布。

**大家行动起来吧！爱心不在大小，数额不在多少，让我们以实际行动表达我们各族裔民众共抗疫情，共同担当的勇气和责任!**

items.title_en: Fighting the Pandemic — Caring Restaurant Series: The Dolar Shop — "One Pot, One World: Yesterday Others Helped Me, Today I Help Others"
items.title_zh: 抗击疫情，爱心餐厅系列介绍之“豆捞坊”：一锅一世界-昨日人渡我，今日我渡人
items.body_en: CCCWA CCCWA _April 11, 2020 13:07_ The "Anti-Pandemic Caring Lunch Fundraising Campaign"—initiated by the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State (CCCWA), with lead donations from The Dolar Shop Chinese restaurant and IJ Sushi Burrito Japanese restaurant—has received an enthusiastic response from Seattle's restaurant community. As of the evening of April 2, besides The Dolar Shop and IJ Sushi Burrito, four more restaurants—Imperial Garden, Chengdu Memory Hot Pot, Frying Fish, and Liuyishou—had newly joined the ranks of caring-lunch donors, pledging to donate 14,150 lunches. They had already prepared 1,515 caring lunches and delivered them into the hands of medical staff at healthcare institutions, community service workers, and community members in need. When asked about the original intention behind spontaneously launching the "Anti-Pandemic Caring Lunch" donation campaign, the head of The Dolar Shop's Seattle branch answered very simply: "One pot, one world: yesterday others helped me, today I help others." I understand him to mean that since entering Seattle in October 2018, people's love has supported the business's growth. Now, amid the severe COVID-19 pandemic in the U.S., when restaurants were forced to close, The Dolar Shop still hoped to do something for the local community, to repay its deep affection over the past year and a half. So The Dolar Shop decided to provide free caring lunches to all in the community who needed them. All of its staff expressed the gratitude of "yesterday others helped me, today I help others" through concrete action. Food is the people's heaven; under pandemic isolation, many restaurants closed, leaving police, community workers, medical staff, taxi drivers, people working and studying from home, and unattended seniors all facing the problem of getting meals. At first, The Dolar Shop's Seattle store voluntarily donated caring lunches, and anyone in need could come to the store to pick up a free one. Perhaps because word spread only so far, or because people didn't believe such a good thing existed, not many came. Later, when the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State learned of this, it took the initiative to contact other Greater Seattle charitable organizations, hospital systems, and more restaurants, to deliver caring lunches to the medical staff on the front lines and benefit more people in need. The Buddha said: in one flower a world, in one tree a life, in one blade of grass a heaven, in one leaf a Buddha, in one grain of sand paradise, in one place a pure land, in one smile a worldly bond, in one thought serenity. The Dolar Shop also put forward its own philosophy: one pot, one world. Each person has their own pot—cleaner and more hygienic—and everyone can choose their own flavors and dishes, while all gathering around one table, savoring delicious food while chatting and laughing. People often even have to wait in line for 2 hours to enjoy their beloved Dolar hot pot. What is the story behind The Dolar Shop brand? According to its head, the concept of "dou lao" comes from Macau. In the past, when people couldn't afford good ingredients, they made seafood into sliced dishes, which were both delicious and affordable and much loved by the people of Macau. Moreover, "dou lao" is a homophone for "all scoop up," symbolizing auspiciousness and prosperity. Later, Macau's dou lao spread to the mainland and became synonymous with luxury, high-end hot pot and an important choice for business banquets. With so many hot pot brands, what makes The Dolar Shop distinctive? According to its head, hot pot can be roughly divided into two types: Sichuan spicy hot pot and Hong Kong-style seafood hot pot. Dou lao belongs to the Hong Kong style, using the freshest seafood to make sliced dishes and selecting the highest-quality beef, paired with a secret-recipe sauce; after eating, you can also drink the nourishing hot pot broth. The Dolar Shop is high-end hot pot, using the best ingredients that can be found—only with good ingredients can the taste be better. Its décor is also the most cutting-edge, and its service the best, always putting guests first. The Dolar Shop also pays great attention to the details customers can't see in the back kitchen, even requiring the copper drain pipes to be polished bright and shiny. It is precisely because of The Dolar Shop's high demand for consistent quality that, since founding the brand in Shanghai in 2004, it has opened 52 directly operated branches worldwide, including four overseas in Seattle, New York, Vancouver, and Sydney. We sincerely thank all of The Dolar Shop's staff for still taking the initiative to give back to society and help the community during the restaurant industry's most difficult time in the pandemic. We sincerely wish The Dolar Shop to become a century-old establishment and a world brand! Blessings to Dolar! The Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State calls on more restaurants to join, and on more institutions, companies, and individuals to join, to help more medical staff and community members in need. Our fundraising campaign is completely open and transparent, strictly complies with U.S. law, and operates strictly according to nonprofit financial regulations; donation amounts and donated food will be published in real time. Let's all take action! Love is not measured by size, nor by amount—let us use concrete action to express the courage and responsibility of our people of all ethnicities to fight the pandemic together and share the burden together! **Supporting Organizations for This Event:** The Dolar Shop (Bruce.zixuan.lin@thedolarshop.com); Asian Family Market; Imperial Garden; Chengdu Memory Hot Pot; Flying Fish; Liuyishou Hot Pot; Seattle Entrepreneurship Club; Seattle Chinese New Immigrants Center; Sunshine Youth Culture and Education Development Association; Seattle Real Estate Investment Club; Jing Wei LLC; Cai & Cai Associates; Pacific Sunrise International Corp. Donation receiving account: Please mail checks to: 325 118th AVE SE #100, Bellevue, WA 98005 (Attn: Xiaoyan Li). Bank account transfer: Cathay Bank. To donate directly, click: gf.me/u/xruzbv (please click from the server). If donating through your company's internal donation website, please search for Sunshine Youth Culture and Education Development Association. ***Donors, please be sure to note your name, address, email, and contact phone number so we can promptly provide your tax-deductible donation receipt.*** IJ Sushi Burrito (kevin100118@gmail.com); Chowbus Inc.; Issaquah Highlands Chinese Heritage Club; SC Intl Realty (206-228-9404); Create World America Real Estate Inc. CCCWA CCCWA 

由华盛顿州中国总商会CCCWA发起倡议，豆捞坊中餐厅、IJ Sushi Burrito日餐厅领捐的“抗击疫 情爱心午餐募捐活动”得到了⻄雅图餐饮届的热烈响应。至4月2日晚，除了豆捞坊和IJ Sushi Burrito日餐厅，又有颐和园、蓉城老火锅、沸腾⻥乡、刘一手等4家餐厅新加入到捐赠爱心午餐的队伍中来，承诺捐赠午餐14,150份，并已制作完成1,515份爱心午餐，送到医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的 社区成员手中。

当被问到为什么主动发起“抗击新冠疫情爱心午餐”捐赠活动的初心时，豆捞坊⻄雅图分店负责人回答非常 简洁:“一锅一世界:昨日人渡我，今日我渡人。”我理解他的意思是，自2018年10月进入⻄雅图以来，人 们的喜爱支撑了企业的发展。当今正直美国新冠疫情严重，饭店被迫关店歇业之时，豆捞坊仍然希望能为当地社区做些什么，以回馈社区一年半以来的厚爱。所以，豆捞坊决定向社区所有需要的人免费提供爱心午餐。豆捞坊全体员工以实际行动表达“昨日人渡我，今日我渡人”的感恩。

⺠以⻝为天，疫情隔离之下，很多饭店关⻔，导致警察、社区工作人员、医护人员、出租⻋司机、居家工 作和学习的人们、无人照料的老人都遇到了吃饭问题。最初豆捞坊⻄雅图店自愿捐献爱心午餐，任何需要 的人都可以到店里领取一份免费爱心午餐。 可能是因为传播有限，或者人们并不相信有这样的好事，来主动领取爱心午餐的人并不多。 后来华盛顿州中国总商会了解到这个情况，主动联系大⻄雅图地区其他公益组织联系医院系统以及更多的饭店，为冲在抗疫救灾第一线的医护人员送上爱心午餐，让更多需要的人受益。

佛曰:一花一世界，一木一浮生，一草一天堂，一叶一如来，一砂一极乐，一方一净土，一笑一尘缘，一念一清静。豆捞坊也提出了自己的理念:一锅一世界。每人一锅，更干净卫生，每个人都可以选择自己的口味和菜品，大家又都聚在一个餐桌上，一边品味美⻝，一边谈笑⻛生。人们甚至常常要排2小时的队才能吃到心爱的豆捞火锅。

豆捞坊品牌背后有什么样的故事呢?据豆捞坊负责人介绍豆捞的概念来自澳⻔，以前人们吃不起好的⻝材，就把海鲜做成滑类，这样既美味又便宜实惠，很受澳⻔人⺠的喜爱。而且豆捞的谐音是“都捞”，寓意吉祥富贵，也能讨个好口彩。后来，澳⻔豆捞传到大陆，成了奢侈高端火锅的代名词，商务宴请的重要选择。火锅品牌众多，豆捞坊有什么自己的特色呢?豆捞坊负责人介绍，火锅大致可以分为两类，四川麻辣火锅和港式海鲜火锅。豆捞就属于港式火锅，用最新鲜的海鲜做成滑类，选择最高品质的牛肉，配以秘制酱 料，吃完还可以喝滋补的火锅靓汤。豆捞坊是高端火锅，选用的都是能找到的最好的⻝材，⻝材好，味道才能更好。豆捞坊的装修也是最超前的，服务也是最好的， 永远把客人放在第一位。豆捞坊还很注意在客人看不到的后厨下功夫，连下水道的铜管都要求擦得铮明瓦亮。正因为豆捞坊对品质一致性的高要求，自2004年在上海创立品牌至今，豆捞坊在全世界开了52家分店都是直营，其中海外有四家店，分别在 ⻄雅图、纽约、温哥华和悉尼。

衷心感谢豆捞坊全体同仁在疫情之下餐饮业最艰难的时刻，仍然主动回馈社会，帮助社区。衷心祝愿豆捞 坊成为百年老店，世界品牌!祝福豆捞!

items.title_en: Second Episode of CCCWA's "Star of the Week" Hotline Continues! Ms. Frances Chen Shares a Special Presentation on Online Marketing Strategies in the US Market
items.title_zh: 第二期CCCWA“每周一星“热线继续热播！Frances Chen女士为大家专题分享美国市场如何进行网络推广
items.body_en: CCCWA CCCWA _April 11, 2020, 13:07_ This episode's guest for CCCWA's (China Chamber of Commerce in Washington State) "Star of the Week" was Ms. Frances Chen, Director of US Marketing at adSage, who introduced the commercial value of digital advertising driven by communication and digital media technology, as well as the current state and outlook of digital advertising development in both China and the US. Amid the current global pandemic, many company employees have been forced to work from home and retail stores have temporarily closed; during this special period, digital online marketing has demonstrated remarkable power, connecting businesses across industries and borders with their audiences and buyers. Frances introduced some advertising platforms and ad formats well-suited to attendees' needs. Frances Chen shared with the online audience the services of adSage, a leading global digital marketing company, and introduced its major clients, including Amazon, Microsoft, Vipshop, Uber, Ashford, Blue Nile, and GoDaddy, giving everyone a primer on the development of the internet advertising industry.
items.body_zh:
CCCWA CCCWA 

本期CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会 “每周一星“的做客嘉宾，我们特别邀请了adSage美国市场营销总监FrancesChen女士向大家介绍网络营销借助通信和数字媒体技术推动的数字广告的商业价值,中美两地数字广告的发展现状及展望。在全球这次疫情爆发的当下，很多公司员工被迫在家办公，零售商店暂停营业，在特殊时期数字化网络营销发挥神奇力量，让各个行业跨国界联系到企业的受众群以及买家。Frances介绍了一些比较适合大家的投放平台以及广告投放形式。

Frances Chen与 在线的朋友们分享了 全球领先的数字营销公司adSage 的服务，并 向大家介绍主要的客户为亚马逊、微软、唯品会、Uber,Ashford、Blue Nile、Go Daddy等， 为大家普及了 互联网广告行业 的发展。

items.body_en: CCCWA CCCWA _April 10, 2020 09:50_ **Attorney Cao will introduce the types of visas and immigration available to multinational companies in the U.S.:** 1. Investment immigration: EB-5 2. Extraordinary-ability immigration: EB-1A 3. Entrepreneur visas and green cards: L-1/L-2, EB-1C 4. Employment-based immigration: EB-1/EB-2/EB-3 5. For countries or regions such as Canada, New Zealand, Taiwan, and Hong Kong: E1/E2, TN **We hope Attorney Cao's professional lecture will help everyone in their work and life in the United States.** Attorney Cao earned her bachelor's degree from China University of Political Science and Law, and later received a master's in public policy from Japan's National Graduate Institute for Policy Studies and a Juris Doctor from Seattle University School of Law. During her legal practice in China, she focused mainly on Chinese business law and served as legal counsel at a large Chinese fuel company. She also co-authored works on Chinese law. After immigrating to the U.S., Attorney Cao began her legal practice here after earning her J.D. from Seattle University School of Law. Whether in immigration law, family law, business law, or estate planning, Attorney Cao has extensive experience, tailoring immigration strategies more comprehensively to different needs to help clients achieve the American Dream—including investment immigration (EB-5 direct investment and regional centers), employment immigration (EB-1, EB-2, EB-3), family immigration, applications for various non-immigrant visas (such as H-1B), and corporate law services. Attorney Cao is also active in many Seattle Chinese community events. She was invited to host an **immigration law column** on a Seattle Chinese radio station and served as a writer for an immigration-law column for overseas Chinese, providing immigration consulting to Chinese friends in the Greater Seattle area. Registration: This event is livestream only. To watch this livestream on Zoom, please click the link below: Pacific Time, Friday, April 10, 8PM-9:30PM (Beijing time, Saturday, 11AM-12:30PM) Join Zoom Meeting https://zoom.us/j/4696970869 Meeting ID: 469 697 0869

1. 投资移民：EB-5

3. 企业家签证及绿卡：L-1/L-2， Eb-1C

4. 职业移民：EB-1/ EB-2/ EB-3

items.body_en:
The 'Fighting COVID-19 Love Lunch Fundraising Drive,' initiated by CCCWA and led by The Dolar Shop, IJ Sushi Burrito, Imperial Garden, Chengdu Memory, Frying Fish, and Liuyishou, has received an enthusiastic response from Seattle's restaurant industry, with these restaurants together pledging a combined $242,250 worth of roughly 14,150 nutritious meal packages to show their thanks and respect for medical staff on the front lines of the pandemic response!

As of the evening of April 7th, the restaurants participating in the drive — despite their own businesses being hit hard by the pandemic — have continued to generously give back to society. Through their funding and staffing, they have already prepared 2,535 love lunches (worth a combined $45,525) and delivered them to medical staff, community service workers, and community members in need.

The 'Love Lunch' drive is proceeding vigorously and smoothly. It has also received enthusiastic support from across the community, with donation totals growing by the day. CCCWA has already received $26,479 in cash donations from generous community members, and many hope to donate even more love lunches through our platform. With the virus still spreading, frontline medical workers have chosen to fight day and night to protect our health, and we too should do our small part, offering our gratitude in the form of a donated meal for these hardworking medical workers!

Right now, frontline medical staff fighting the pandemic at UW Virology, Swedish Hospital, Overlake Hospital, and Evergreen Hospital have already enjoyed these love lunches. Many medical workers, upon receiving their love lunches, were deeply grateful and expressed their thanks to CCCWA and the sponsoring restaurants through social media! Staff at UW Virology posted on Facebook: 'These love lunches are simply delicious.' The 'Love Lunch' drive will continue to expand its reach to more medical staff, community service workers, and community members in need. These freshly prepared, nutritious meal packages have brought us closer to medical staff and community service workers, united in the same spirit of love and gratitude.

The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State calls on more restaurants, organizations, companies, and individuals to join in, to help more medical workers and community members in need. Our fundraising drive is fully transparent, strictly complies with US law, and strictly follows nonprofit financial regulations — donation amounts and donated food will be published on an ongoing basis in real time. Let's all take action! No act of love is too small — let's show, through real action, our courage and shared responsibility in fighting this epidemic together across all communities.

Supporting organizations for this event: The Dolar Shop (contact via email), Asian Family Market, IJ Sushi Burrito (contact via email), Chowbus Inc., Imperial Garden, Chengdu Memory, Frying Fish, Liuyishou Hot Pot, Seattle Entrepreneurship Club, Seattle Chinese New Immigrants Center, Sunshine Youth Culture and Education Development Association, Seattle Real Estate Investment Club, Issaquah Highlands Chinese Heritage Club, Jing Wei LLC, SC Intl Realty (206-228-9404), Cai & Cai Associates, Create World America Real Estate Inc., Pacific Sunrise International Corp

截至4月7日晚， 参与爱心活动的几家餐厅在生意受到疫情打击下，依然慷慨尽力 为社会做贡献。他们 出资金、安排人力已制作完成2,535份爱心午餐(合计$4,5525美金）并送到医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的 社区成员手中。

“爱心午餐”活动开展得如火如荼并且有条不紊地进行着。活动也得到社会各界的热情支持，爱心捐款数目与日俱增。 CCCWA已经收到了各界热心人士的现金捐赠美金$26,479，大家希望通过我们的平台捐赠更多的爱心餐。 病毒当前，前线的医务人员选择日夜奋战，全力保护着我们的健康，我们也当进绵薄之力，为辛苦的医务人员捐上一份感激之心!

现在，UW Virology、Swedish Hospital、Overlake Hospital 、Evergreen Hospital医院里奋战在抗疫一线的医护人员们已经享用到爱心午餐。很多医护人员收到爱心午餐后都感激不尽， **通过自媒体发表了他们对CCCWA和赞助餐厅的感谢心声！** UW Virology的医护人员在Facebook上说： **“这些爱心午餐简直太美味了“**。“爱心午餐”活动还将普及到更多医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的社区成员手里。 新鲜烹制的爱心 营养套餐将我们和医疗人员、社区服务人员拉近了距离，我们都有同样的爱心和感恩之情。

华盛顿州中国总商会倡议更多的餐饮企业加入进来，倡议更多的机构、公司和个人加入进来，为更多的医护人员和社区里需要救助的群体提供帮助。我们的募捐活动完全公开透明，严格遵守美国法律，且严格按照非营利机构的财务规定运作，捐款数目和捐助食品都将实时公布。

items.body_en:
Since the CCCWA Foundation's donation channel launched on March 20th, it has partnered with the Xiamen University Alumni Association in Seattle, the Zhejiang University North America Seattle Alumni Association, and Chamber member companies to form a working group that raised, within just one week, nearly $39,000 in cash donations and close to $100,000 worth of supplies from across the community — delivering supplies donated by member company Systimmune Inc. to Everett Providence Hospital and Overlake Medical Center on the very day the channel launched.

The entire fundraising effort brought together tens of thousands of acts of generosity time and again, bearing witness to an unprecedented level of unity within the Chinese community. As soon as the call went out, over a hundred people joined the CCCWA Foundation donation group, while the Xiamen University Seattle Alumni Association and the Zhejiang University North America Seattle Alumni Association separately rallied and fundraised within their own alumni groups, bringing total participation to over 300 people. Donors included not only Chinese-invested businesses, prominent entrepreneurs, dignitaries, and professionals across industries in the Seattle area, but also many local organizations and generous individuals — many of whom had already donated multiple times yet still chose to give again. All of this effort was possible because we share a common goal and wish: to stand united, fight COVID-19, and protect our community!

During this extraordinary period of overwhelmed courier services and disrupted shipping routes, the CCCWA Foundation working group raced against time to coordinate with various organizations, ensuring the quality and safety of supplies, and worked with professional trading companies to deliver them to the Seattle area as quickly as possible. To date, the CCCWA Foundation has visited 14 organizations, donating 82,000 masks and 1,500 sets of protective supplies (including medical gloves, protective gowns, and goggles), with a large batch of additional supplies still in transit. The donations received heartfelt thanks and recognition from recipient organizations, and the image of a united Chinese community resonated widely, drawing coverage from mainstream media outlets such as KIRO 7.

On March 27th, the working group delivered supplies to Issaquah Swedish Hospital, which hospital staff carried directly to ICU medical workers. The medical staff called it help arriving exactly when needed, thanking the Chinese community for its care and protection.

KIRO 7 coverage: CCCWA Foundation representatives and Xiamen University Seattle Alumni Association representatives

Swedish Hospital ICU staff receiving the supplies

On March 31st, CCCWA Foundation working group representatives delivered donations to Virginia Mason Medical Center, Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center, and the Bellevue Police and Fire Departments. Virginia Mason CEO Gary Kaplan sent a personal letter of thanks to the CCCWA Foundation.

Representatives donating to Virginia Mason Medical Center

Representatives donating to Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center

Representatives donating to Bellevue City Hall

From April 1st to 3rd, CCCWA Foundation working group representatives made back-to-back visits to deliver donations to UW Valley Medical Center, Evergreen Hospital, Overlake Medical Center, the International Community Health Services (ICHS) International District Medical and Dental Clinic, and Burien's Highline Medical Center. Burien Mayor Jimmy Matta personally wrote a letter of thanks to the CCCWA Foundation, writing movingly: 'As COVID-19 ravages our community, your help has shown us a light of hope at the end of the tunnel. Our entire community thanks you.'

Burien Mayor Jimmy Matta's letter of thanks

Dr. Martin Walker posted his thanks on Facebook

The CCCWA President and Seattle Real Estate Club representatives donating to Overlake Medical Center

Representatives donating to the ICHS International District Medical and Dental Clinic

Representatives donating to UW Valley Medical Center

Evergreen Hospital doctors receiving the donation

Washington State's outbreak has now begun to stabilize — not only because of the tireless efforts of doctors and the cooperation of the broader community, but also because of the unified dedication and support of the entire Chinese community. Many of us are first-generation immigrants; we draw on strength from our home country to support the home we live in now, because we deeply love this land. Every drop joins the river — small efforts help the community. The CCCWA Foundation will continue rallying the community to donate, until victory is declared in this fight against the pandemic! (Report and photos by Carrie Wang — CCCWA Foundation)

Hosted by: CCCWA Foundation

Partner organizations: Xiamen University Alumni Association Seattle (XMUAASEATTLE), ICBC USA, Modern Land Seattle LLC, MY International Real Estate, Onelin Capital Corporation, Create World Real Estate, Seattle Real Estate Investment Club, Systimmune Inc., iSoftStone, adSage, Washington Property, Chinese American Mixed Family Association, 505 Group, China-US-Canada Friendship Association

The donation channel is now open. Donors, donated items and quantities, and recipient details will be transparently published on an ongoing basis. Please continue to follow the CCCWA Foundation for details on the donation drive. 'Every drop joins the river — small efforts help the community!'

华盛顿州中国总商会基金会（以下称CCCWA Foundation）捐赠通道自3月20日启动以来，联合厦门大学西雅图校友会（Xiamen UniversityAlumni Association in Seattle）、浙江大学北美西雅图校友会（Zhejiang University North AmericaSeattleAlumni）、总商会会员单位组成工作组，在短短一周内共筹集来自社会各界的资金捐赠近3万9千美金以及价值近10万美金的物资，并在通道启动当天将百利药业（SystimmuneInc）捐赠的物资送达EverettProvidence Hospital及Overlake Medical Center.

整个筹款过程一次又一次凝聚了数万的爱心，见证了华人空前的团结。倡议书一经发出就号召聚集了百人加入CCCWAFoundation捐赠群，同时厦门大学西雅图校友会及浙江大学北美西雅图校友会分别在其校友群中进行号召和筹款，总参与人数超过300人。

此次捐赠者中不仅有西雅图地区的中资企业、知名企业家、政要、来自各行各业的精英，还有众多本地机构、组织和爱心人士，其中许多个人和单位已经几度捐款，但依旧再次献出爱心；所有的努力都因为我们有着共同的目标和心愿：团结一心、抗击新冠、保护社区！

在快递爆仓，航路不畅的特殊时期，CCCWAFoundation工作组争分夺秒对接各单位，确保物资的质量及安全性。并在专业外贸公司的协助下尽可能以最高的速度送达西雅图地区。截至日前，CCCWAFoundation共前往14家机构，捐出8万2千个口罩及1500套防护物资（含医用手套、防护服及护目镜）,仍有大批物品还在运送途中。捐赠得到了受赠单位由衷的感谢和肯定，华人众志成城的形象深入人心，并被主流媒体：如KIRO 7电视频道报道。

3月27日工作组将物资送达Issaquah Swedish Hospital,并由医院工作人员直接送至ICU的医护手中。医护人员都称这真是雪中送炭，感谢来自中国社区的关爱和保护。

items.summary_en: This episode's guest for CCCWA's 'Star of the Week' series was Frances Chen, adSage's US Marketing Director, who introduced the business value of digital advertising powered by communications and digital media technology, along with the current state and outlook for digital advertising in China and the US.
items.summary_zh: ​ 本期CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会 “每周一星“的做客嘉宾，我们特别邀请了adSage美国市场营销总监Frances...
items.body_en:
This episode's guest for CCCWA's 'Star of the Week' series was Frances Chen, adSage's US Marketing Director, who introduced the business value of digital advertising powered by communications and digital media technology, along with the current state and outlook for digital advertising in China and the US. Amid the current global pandemic, many company employees have been forced to work from home and retail stores have shut down — in these extraordinary times, digital online marketing has shown its remarkable power, letting businesses across every industry reach their audiences and buyers across borders. Frances introduced several platforms and ad formats well suited for this.

Frances Chen shared with online attendees the services of adSage, a globally leading digital marketing company, introducing its major clients including Amazon, Microsoft, Vipshop, Uber, Ashford, Blue Nile, and GoDaddy, giving everyone a broader understanding of the development of the internet advertising industry.
items.body_zh:
本期CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会 “每周一星“的做客嘉宾，我们特别邀请了adSage美国市场营销总监Frances Chen女士向大家介绍网络营销借助通信和数字媒体技术推动的数字广告的商业价值,中美两地数字广告的发展现状及展望。在全球这次疫情爆发的当下，很多公司员工被迫在家办公，零售商店暂停营业，在特殊时期数字化网络营销发挥神奇力量，让各个行业跨国界联系到企业的受众群以及买家。Frances 介绍了一些比较适合大家的投放平台以及广告投放形式。

Frances Chen与在线的朋友们分享了全球领先的数字营销公司adSage 的服务，并向大家介绍主要的客户为亚马逊、微软、唯品会、Uber,Ashford、Blue Nile、Go Daddy等， 为大家普及了互联网广告行业的发展。

items.title_en: April 3 CCCWA Anti-Pandemic Caring Lunch Charity Follow-Up Report
items.title_zh: 4月3日CCCWA抗击疫情爱心午餐公益追踪报道
items.body_en: CCCWA CCCWA _April 4, 2020 12:22_ The **"Anti-Pandemic Caring Lunch Fundraising Campaign"**—initiated by the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State (CCCWA), with lead donations from The Dolar Shop Chinese restaurant (together with Asian Family Market) and IJ Sushi Burrito Japanese restaurant—has received an enthusiastic response from all sectors of Seattle. Over the past few days, the frontline anti-pandemic units that received caring lunches include: UW Virology, Swedish Hospital, Overlake Hospital, and Evergreen Hospital. This campaign selected safe and reliable food and delivery businesses, producing and transporting the food in strict accordance with Washington State food safety standards to deliver nutritious and delicious caring lunches into the hands of medical staff. All food purchased was coordinated closely with local medical institutions at every level and delivered through point-to-point contact with the recipient hospitals. The caring-lunch fundraising initiative drew an enthusiastic response, with many organizations such as the Seattle Entrepreneurship Club giving strong support and assistance. Following the lead donations from The Dolar Shop and IJ Sushi, as of the evening of April 2, four more restaurants—Imperial Garden, Chengdu Memory Hot Pot, Frying Fish, and Liuyishou—had joined the ranks of donors, together pledging to fully fund 14,150 lunches. They had already prepared 1,515 caring lunches, delivered into the hands of medical staff at healthcare institutions, community service workers, and community members in need, and had raised $21,085 in cash donations. The Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State calls on more restaurants to join, and on more institutions, companies, and individuals to join, to help more medical staff and community members in need. Our fundraising campaign is completely open and transparent, strictly complies with U.S. law, and operates strictly according to nonprofit financial regulations; donation amounts and donated food will be published in real time. Let's all take action! Love is not measured by size, nor by amount—let us use concrete action to express the courage and responsibility of our people of all ethnicities to fight the pandemic together and share the burden together! **Supporting Organizations for This Event:** Asian Family Market, Imperial Garden, Chengdu Memory Hot Pot, Frying Fish, Liuyishou Hot Pot, Seattle Entrepreneurship Club, Seattle Chinese New Immigrants Center, Sunshine Youth Culture and Education Development Association, Seattle Real Estate Investment Club, Jing Wei LLC, Cai & Cai Associates, and Pacific Sunrise International Corp. **Donation Receiving Account:** By check: Sunshine Youth Culture and Education Development Association. Please mail checks to: 325 118th AVE SE #100, Bellevue, WA 98005 (Attn: Xiaoyan Li). Bank account transfer: Cathay Bank. To donate directly, click the website: gf.me/u/xruzbv (please click from the server). If donating through your company's internal donation website, please search for Sunshine Youth Culture and Education Development Association. ***Donors, please be sure to note your name, address, email, and contact phone number so we can promptly provide your tax-deductible donation receipt.*** The Dolar Shop (Bruce.zixuan.lin@thedolarshop.com); IJ Sushi Burrito (kevin100118@gmail.com); Chowbus Inc.; Issaquah Highlands Chinese Heritage Club; SC Intl Realty (206-228-9404); Create World America Real Estate Inc. CCCWA CCCWA 

华盛顿州中国总商会CCCWA发起倡议、豆捞坊中餐厅（联合百家超市）IJ Sushi Burrito日餐厅领捐的 “ **抗击疫情爱心午餐募捐活动**”得到了西雅图各界的热烈回应。过去几天奋战在抗疫第一线收到爱心午餐的单位包括：UW Virology 华大病毒实验室、Swedish Hospital瑞士医院、Overlake Hospital 欧弗莱克医院、Evergreen Hospital 长青医院。

这次活动挑选了安全可靠的餐饮企业和食品配送企业，严格按照华州食品安全标准生产和运输，将营养美味的爱心午餐送到医护人员手上。所采购食品，均通过与本地各级医疗机构密切沟通后，与受赠医院保持点对点联系.

爱心午餐募捐倡议推出后反响热烈,西雅图创业协会等多个组织给与此次活动大力支持和协助。继豆捞坊和IJsushine领捐后，截止4月2日晚，已有颐和园、蓉城老火锅、沸腾鱼乡、刘一手 4家餐厅新加入到捐赠单位队伍中，共承诺全资捐赠午餐 14,150份，并已制作了 1,515 份爱心午餐，送到医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的社区成员手里。募集到现金捐赠 $21,085美元。

华盛顿州中国总商会倡议更多的餐饮企业加入进来，倡议更多的机构、公司和个人加入进来，为更多的医护人员和社区里需要救助的群体提供帮助。我们的募捐活动完全公开透明，严格遵守美国法律，且严格按照非营利机构的财务规定运作，捐款数目和捐助食品都将实时公布。大家行动起来吧！爱心不在大小，数额不在多少，让我们以实际行动表达我们各族裔民众共抗疫情，共同担当的勇气和责任！

items.title_en: CCCWA Weekly Star April 3 Preview: How to Do Online Marketing in the U.S. Market
items.title_zh: CCCWA 每周一星4月3日活动预告：美国市场如何进行网络推广
items.body_en: CCCWA CCCWA _April 1, 2020 07:39_ Founded in 2007, adSage (Adsage Technology Co., Ltd.) is known for big-data mining and precision marketing. Headquartered in Beijing, with branch offices in Shanghai, Wuxi, Shenzhen, Seattle, Los Angeles, and elsewhere, the company is dedicated to providing clients with one-stop integrated "brand-plus-performance" marketing services in the digital media marketing field. Advertising is information, serving both brand communication and demand conversion, and all advertising is measurable. Good ads that fit the audience's interests and ads that can be measured both require continuous, cutting-edge technology investment. adSage firmly believes technology can transform marketing, and we continuously invest substantial R&D effort into this great work to better serve our clients. **Innovation + Execution:** Innovation is the foundation of a technology company's existence and the engine of its growth, but innovation must be put into practice, not remain merely a concept—so execution is the key element that ensures innovation is realized. In this fast-developing tech era, digitizing products and services has become a necessary process. Especially amid this pandemic outbreak, many companies have been forced to work from home, and many traditional retailers have been hit hard, forced to close or lay off staff, with some even going bankrupt. How can you reach your audience and buyers across distances and borders during special times? This is where digital online marketing works its magic. Today we'll introduce some platforms and ad formats well suited to everyone. The Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State has invited adSage's U.S. marketing director Frances Chen to introduce the business value of digital advertising driven by communication and digital media technology, and the current state and outlook of digital advertising in both China and the U.S. Since joining the company in 2017, Frances has helped many clients such as Blue Nile, Zillow, and TD Ameritrade expand their global market share, drawing on her skills and experience in brand management, building partnerships, and performance marketing. **Frances manages adSage's media partners | OnlineTimes Corporation,** **including Tencent, North America's Money Saving Express, TikTok, Baidu, and more. Everyone is welcome to register!** Registration: This event is livestream only. To watch this livestream on Zoom, please click the link below: Join Zoom Meeting https://zoom.us/j/292364477 Meeting ID: 292 364 477
items.body_zh:
CCCWA CCCWA 

艾德思奇科技有限公司（艾德思奇/adSage）成立于2007年，以大数据挖掘和精准营销著称。公司总部位于北京，于上海、无锡、深圳、西雅图、洛杉矶等地设有分支机构，致力于为客户提供数字媒体营销领域的“品效合一”一站式整合营销服务。

广告就是信息，兼具品牌传播和需求转化的作用，但任何广告都是可衡量的。贴合受众兴趣的好广告和能够衡量的广告，都需要持续并且尖端的科技投入。adSage坚信科技可以改变营销，我们为持续的为这一伟大的工作投入大量研发精力来为客户更好的服务。

**创新力+执行力** **：** 创新是科技公司存在的根本和发展的动力，但创新必须付诸实践，而不仅是概念，因此执行力是保障创新被实现的关键要素。

在高速发展的科技时代，把产品以及服务电子化已成为一个必要的过程。尤其是在这次疫情爆发的前提下，很多公司被迫在家办公，很多传统零售业受到重创，不得不关门乃至裁员，有一些甚至破产。如何在特殊时期跨低于跨国界联系到你的受众群以及买家？这就是数字化网络营销发挥神奇力量的地方。今天我们就来介绍一下一些比较适合大家的投放平台以及广告投放形式。

华盛顿州中国总商会邀请adSage美国营销总监Frances Chen向大家介绍网络营销借助通信和数字媒体技术推动的数字广告的商业价值,中美两地数字广告的发展现状及展望。

自2017年加入公司以来，Frances凭借其在品牌管理，建立伙伴关系和绩效营销方面的技能和经验，已帮助BlueNile，Zillow，TDAmeritrade等众多客户扩大了全球市场额。 **Frances管理adSage的媒体合作伙伴| OnlineTimesCorporation，** **包括腾讯，北美省钱快报，Tiktok，百度等。欢迎大家报名参加！**

items.title_en: CCCWA Anti-Pandemic Caring Lunch Fundraising Proposal
items.title_zh: CCCWA抗击疫情爱心午餐募捐倡议书
items.body_en: Original CCCWA CCCWA _March 31, 2020 09:04_ **COVID-19 has now become a disaster faced by people around the world. Washington State—our second hometown where we live—has begun to see shortages of medical supplies such as masks and protective suits. Many restaurants have closed, and frontline medical staff are overloaded with work, sometimes with no time even to eat.** At this once-in-a-century moment of crisis, CCCWA (the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State) and several other organizations, after their campaign to raise funds and purchase medical supplies, have once again launched a charitable campaign to deliver free caring lunches to frontline medical staff. CCCWA will join with several organizations and mobilize the strength of all sectors to select safe, reliable food and delivery businesses, produce and transport the food in strict accordance with Washington State food safety standards, and deliver nutritious, delicious caring meal boxes into the hands of medical staff; in staffing, in donation channels, and in the use of funds, it strictly complies with U.S. donation law. All food purchased is coordinated closely with local medical institutions at every level and delivered through point-to-point contact with the recipient hospitals. **This campaign is led in donations by The Dolar Shop Chinese restaurant (together with Asian Family Market) and IJ Sushi Burrito Japanese restaurant:** 1. The Dolar Shop, together with Asian Family Market, pledged $120,000. 2. The Dolar Shop separately pledged an additional $84,000. 3. IJ Sushi Burrito pledged $108,000. 4. Chowbus Inc.'s professional delivery service pledged $30,000. Recipient organizations already lined up include: UW Virology, Swedish Hospital, Overlake Hospital, and Evergreen Hospital. This campaign plans to raise $400,000 within one month and make 30,000 caring lunches to deliver into the hands of medical staff at healthcare institutions, community service workers, and community members in need. Encouragingly, even before the proposal was issued, Attorney Cai Qing of Cai & Cai Law Firm and Ms. Sylvia Chin did a great deal of work in the campaign's early stages; the Washington Chamber has received over $10,000 in cash donations from Li Ruoyao and Zhang Shuo of Jing Wei LLC and from other businesses and individuals; and The Dolar Shop and IJ Sushi Burrito had already provided a week of free caring lunches to all sectors of society, to an enthusiastic response. The Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State calls on more restaurants to join, and on more institutions, companies, and individuals to join, to help more medical staff and community members in need. Our fundraising campaign is completely open and transparent, strictly complies with U.S. law, and operates strictly according to nonprofit financial regulations; donation amounts and donated food will be published in real time. Though mountains and rivers separate us, we share the same moon and sky. We love our motherland thousands of miles away, and we also love this land beneath our feet. Fellow Washingtonians, let us cheer on our second hometown—this is the home where we work and live, the happy land where our children grow up healthy. Now we need to stand together with Americans of all ethnicities, work with one heart, and fight the pandemic together. We will do our utmost to give back to the community and express the love and dedication of us Chinese Americans to our second hometown. May heaven bestow compassion and grant peace; may the world be well and humanity harmonious. Let's all take action! Love is not measured by size, nor by amount—let us use concrete action to express the courage and responsibility of our people of all ethnicities to fight the pandemic together and share the burden together! **Host of This Event: CCCWA (Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State)** **Supporting Organizations for This Event:** Asian Family Market; Seattle Real Estate Investment Club; Seattle Chinese New Immigrants Center; Sunshine Youth Culture and Education Development Association; Jing Wei LLC; Cai & Cai Associates; SC Intl Realty (206-228-9404). **Donation Receiving Account:** Bank account transfer: Cathay Bank. If donating through a company donation website: please also search for Sunshine Youth Culture and Education Development Association. Check mailing address: 325 118th AVE SE #100, Bellevue, WA 98005 (Attn: Xiaoyan Li). **Donors, please be sure to note your name, address, email, and contact phone number so we can promptly provide your tax-deductible donation receipt.** **Volunteer group contacts for this event:** **For restaurant donation participation and institutional cooperation, please contact:** Overall commander: CCCWA President Lily Lyu, email: lvlili0219@sina.com, WeChat: lili2999. Chief attorney: Cai Qing of Cai & Cai Law Firm, email: Alex.cai@cai-law.com, Tel: 425-753-5188. Delivery group leader. **To donate funds as a company or individual, please contact** finance group leader Li Xiaoyan (Sunshine Youth Education Foundation / Seattle Real Estate Club), eli@create-world.us. **Medical institutions needing caring meal boxes, please contact** the outreach group leader. **For media and CCCWA chamber matters, please contact:** Lei, email: info@ccc-wa.org, WeChat: gloriachatting.

**目前新冠病毒已成为全世界人民共同面对的灾难。我们生活居住的第二故乡华盛顿州开始出现口罩、防护服等医用物品告急。很多饭店歇业，一线医护人员超负荷工作，甚至连饭都没时间吃。**

值此百年不遇之危难时刻，CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会等多家机构在募捐采购医用物资活动之后再次发起为一线医护人员免费配送爱心午餐的公益活动。CCCWA将联合多家机构、发动各界力量，挑选安全可靠的餐饮企业和食品配送企业，严格按照华州食品安全标准生产和运输，将营养美味的爱心便当送到医护人员手上；在人员调配上，在受赠渠道上，在善款使用上，均严格遵守美国捐赠法律的规定。所采购食品，均通过与本地各级医疗机构密切沟通后，与受赠医院保持点对点联系。

**此活动由豆捞坊中餐厅（联合百家超市）和IJ Sushi Burrito日餐厅领捐**： 1，豆捞坊联合百佳超市认捐价值12万美金,2，豆捞坊独自额外认捐价值8.4万美金。3，IJ Sushi Burrito认捐价值10.8万美金。4, Chowbus Inc专业配送服务认捐价值3万美金。目前已联系好的的受赠单位包括：UW Virology 华大病毒实验室、Swedish Hospital瑞士医院、Overlake Hospital 欧弗莱克医院、Evergreen Hospital 长青医院。

此活动计划在一个月内募集40万美元，制作3万份爱心午餐，送到医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的社区成员手里。可喜的是，在倡议书尚未发出之际，蔡和蔡律师事务所的蔡清律师和SylviaChin女士在活动初期做了大量的工作，华盛顿总商会已收到美国经纬有限公司李若垚、张硕夫妇及其他企业个人捐赠的超过1万美金现金，豆捞坊和IJ SushiBurrito已为社会各界提供了一周的免费爱心午餐，反响热烈。

华盛顿州中国总商会倡议更多的餐饮企业加入进来，倡议更多的机构、公司和个人加入进来，为更多的医护人员和社区里需要救助的群体提供帮助。我们的募捐活动完全公开透明，严格遵守美国法律，且严格按照非营利机构的财务规定运作，捐款数目和捐助食品都将实时公布。山川异域，风月同天。我们爱万里之遥的祖国，也爱脚下的这片土地。华州的父老乡亲们，让我们为第二故乡加油，这里是我们工作生活的家园，这里是我们的孩子健康成长的乐土。现在，我们需要和美国的各族裔站在一起，齐心协力、共同抵抗疫情。我们尽最大的努力，回馈社区，表达我们美国华人对第二故乡的爱和奉献。愿天降怜爱，赐予太平；愿世界安好，人类祥和。大家行动起来吧！爱心不在大小，数额不在多少，让我们以实际行动表达我们各族裔民众共抗疫情，共同担当的勇气和责任！

items.body_en:
This drive is led by The Dolar Shop (jointly with Asian Family Market) and IJ Sushi Burrito. The Dolar Shop, together with Asian Family Market, has pledged $120,000 in value; The Dolar Shop has separately pledged an additional $84,000; IJ Sushi Burrito has pledged $108,000; and Chowbus Inc. professional delivery services has pledged $30,000. Recipient organizations already confirmed include: UW Virology, Swedish Hospital, Overlake Hospital, and Evergreen Hospital.

The drive plans to raise $400,000 within a month and prepare 30,000 love lunches, delivering them to medical staff, community service workers, and community members in need. Even before this call for donations was formally published, Attorney Cai Qing of Cai & Cai Law Office and Ms. Sylvia Chin had already done substantial early groundwork — CCCWA has already received over $10,000 in cash donations from Ruoyao Li and Shuo Zhang of Jing Wei LLC and other companies and individuals, and The Dolar Shop and IJ Sushi Burrito have already provided a full week of free love lunches to the community, to an enthusiastic response.

The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State calls on more restaurants, organizations, companies, and individuals to join in, to help more medical workers and community members in need. Our fundraising drive is fully transparent, strictly complies with US law, and strictly follows nonprofit financial regulations — donation amounts and donated food will be published on an ongoing basis in real time.

Though separated by mountains and rivers, we share the same moon and sky. We love our homeland thousands of miles away, and we love the land beneath our feet. Fellow Washingtonians — let's cheer on our second hometown; this is where we live and work, and where our children grow up healthy and happy. Now, we need to stand together with people of all backgrounds in America and fight this epidemic together. We will do our utmost to give back to our community, and to express Chinese Americans' love for and devotion to our second home. May heaven show mercy and grant peace; may the world be well and humanity live in harmony. Let's all take action! No act of love is too small — let's show, through real action, our courage and shared responsibility in fighting this epidemic together across all communities.

Hosted by: CCCWA — Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State

Supporting organizations: The Dolar Shop, IJ Sushi Burrito, Asian Family Market, Chowbus Inc., Seattle Real Estate Investment Club, Seattle Chinese New Immigrants Center, Sunshine Youth Culture and Education Development Association, Issaquah Highlands Chinese Heritage Club, Jing Wei LLC, Create World America Real Estate Inc., Cai & Cai Associates, SC Intl Realty (206-228-9404)

**目前新冠病毒已成为全世界人民共同面对的灾难。我们生活居住的第二故乡华盛顿州开始出现口罩、防护服等医用物品告急。很多饭店歇业，一线医护人员超负荷工作，甚至连饭都没时间吃。**

值此百年不遇之危难时刻，CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会等多家机构在募捐采购医用物资活动之后再次发起为一线医护人员免费配送爱心午餐的公益活动。CCCWA将联合多家机构、发动各界力量，挑选安全可靠的餐饮企业和食品配送企业，严格按照华州食品安全标准生产和运输，将营养美味的爱心便当送到医护人员手上；在人员调配上，在受赠渠道上，在善款使用上，均严格遵守美国捐赠法律的规定。所采购食品，均通过与本地各级医疗机构密切沟通后，与受赠医院保持点对点联系。

**此活动由豆捞坊中餐厅（联合百家超市）和IJ Sushi Burrito日餐厅领捐**： 1，豆捞坊联合百佳超市认捐价值12万美金,2，豆捞坊独自额外认捐价值8.4万美金。3，IJ Sushi Burrito认捐价值10.8万美金。4, Chowbus Inc专业配送服务认捐价值3万美金。目前已联系好的的受赠单位包括：UW Virology 华大病毒实验室、Swedish Hospital瑞士医院、Overlake Hospital 欧弗莱克医院、Evergreen Hospital 长青医院。

此活动计划在一个月内募集40万美元，制作3万份爱心午餐，送到医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的社区成员手里。可喜的是，在倡议书尚未发出之际，蔡和蔡律师事务所的蔡清律师和SylviaChin女士在活动初期做了大量的工作，华盛顿总商会已收到美国经纬有限公司李若垚、张硕夫妇及其他企业个人捐赠的超过1万美金现金，豆捞坊和IJ SushiBurrito已为社会各界提供了一周的免费爱心午餐，反响热烈。

华盛顿州中国总商会倡议更多的餐饮企业加入进来，倡议更多的机构、公司和个人加入进来，为更多的医护人员和社区里需要救助的群体提供帮助。我们的募捐活动完全公开透明，严格遵守美国法律，且严格按照非营利机构的财务规定运作，捐款数目和捐助食品都将实时公布。山川异域，风月同天。我们爱万里之遥的祖国，也爱脚下的这片土地。华州的父老乡亲们，让我们为第二故乡加油，这里是我们工作生活的家园，这里是我们的孩子健康成长的乐土。现在，我们需要和美国的各族裔站在一起，齐心协力、共同抵抗疫情。我们尽最大的努力，回馈社区，表达我们美国华人对第二故乡的爱和奉献。愿天降怜爱，赐予太平；愿世界安好，人类祥和。大家行动起来吧！爱心不在大小，数额不在多少，让我们以实际行动表达我们各族裔民众共抗疫情，共同担当的勇气和责任！

items.body_en: CCCWA CCCWA _March 28, 2020, 13:12_ **CCCWA's weekly video sharing series officially launched on March 23. Member companies and enterprise representatives from home and abroad shared professional knowledge and introduced their company's products and services through an online platform.** **The guest for the first episode of CCCWA's (China Chamber of Commerce in Washington State) "Star of the Week" was Mr. Xia Yinglin, who has extensive work and entrepreneurial experience in China, Japan, Canada, the United States, and many other countries around the world. He gave a special presentation on "Differences and Communication in Chinese and American Corporate Culture." Mr. Xia systematically shared his understanding of what constitutes good and effective communication within American culture, covering topics such as culture and personality, teamwork, in-person and phone meetings, and how to write emails and work reports, and answered practical questions about Chinese-American cultural communication and business cooperation. Drawing on his extensive work experience and real-world case studies, this professional promptly addressed questions raised by attendees, and the nearly 40 participants online were inspired in many ways. Everyone looks forward to CCCWA continuing to host various themed lectures in the future, in order to receive the latest industry information from professionals. CCCWA hopes to get to know more members and provide everyone with a platform for exchange, sharing, and cooperation — working together for a win-win 2020!**
