items.title_en: CCCWA Star of the Week — March 26th Event Preview: Cultural Differences and Communication Between US and Chinese Companies
items.title_zh: CCCWA 每周一星-3月26日活动预告：中美企业文化的差异与沟通
items.summary_en: As the world's two largest economies, the US and China have increasingly frequent economic and social exchange. Along with this comes growing political and economic friction, such as the trade war. So what should we keep in mind about cross-cultural communication while working, living, starting businesses, and doing business in the US?
items.summary_zh: 中美作为世界上两个最大的经济体，经济社会交往越来越频繁。随之而来，以贸易战为代表的政治经济摩擦也越来越多。那么我们在美国工作、生活以及创业、营商过程中，在跨文化沟通方面有什么需要注意的吗？
items.body_en:
As the world's two largest economies, the US and China have increasingly frequent economic and social exchange. Along with this comes growing political and economic friction, such as the trade war. So what should we keep in mind about cross-cultural communication while working, living, starting businesses, and doing business in the US?

This week's guest for CCCWA's 'Star of the Week' series is Mr. Yinglin Xia, who brings rich work and entrepreneurial experience from China, Japan, Canada, the US, and other countries around the world, sharing a special presentation on 'Cultural Differences and Communication Between US and Chinese Companies.' Mr. Xia will systematically share his understanding of what makes for good and effective communication within American culture, covering topics such as culture and personality, teamwork, in-person and phone meetings, and how to write emails and work reports. We hope Mr. Xia's excellent lecture will be helpful for everyone's work and life in the US.

Yinglin Xia: Founder and President of Dilato Infotech Limited. Mr. Xia earned his master's degree in Computer Science from Beijing Jiaotong University in 1987. Before founding his own company, he worked as a software engineer at China's Ministry of Railways, as a software engineer at Tokyo Systems Laboratories in Tokyo, Japan, as a software engineer at DATT Japan in Vancouver, Canada, as a software localization engineer at SimulTrans in Mountain View, USA, as a senior localization engineer at Adobe Systems in San Jose, USA, as a senior localization engineer at Netscape in Mountain View, USA, as a software localization engineer at Microsoft in Redmond, USA, and as Director of Product Globalization Services at hiSoft Technology International Limited in Seattle, USA.

How to join: This event is livestream-only. To watch the livestream, please click the following link: https://zoom.us/j/4696970869 Meeting ID: 469 697 0869

items.body_en: Original CCCWA CCCWA _March 24, 2020, 06:00_ As COVID-19 spreads worldwide, the number of confirmed cases and deaths in Washington State is rising sharply by the day. Frontline hospitals fighting the epidemic, such as Evergreen Hospital, Overlake Hospital, Swedish Hospital, and Seattle Children's Hospital, have all experienced severe shortages of basic protective supplies such as masks and hand sanitizer. To support community public health and relieve the urgent needs of frontline medical institutions, the CCCWA Foundation (China Chamber of Commerce in Washington State Foundation) urgently formed a donation task force, racing against time to mobilize resources from all sectors of society, and issued a call for donations to Chamber member companies, alumni associations, and other organizations to overcome this challenge together. On March 20, the day the donation channel officially launched, the CCCWA Foundation received a donation from member company SystImmune Inc. (Baili Pharmaceutical) of 2,000 3M N95 masks, 2,000 medical-grade masks, 400 protective goggles, and 100 sets of protective suits, and delivered them that same afternoon to Everett Providence Hospital and Overlake Medical Center. **The donation channel is now open, and details of donors, donated items, quantities, and recipients will be transparently disclosed to the public on an ongoing basis.** **Please stay tuned for further updates on the CCCWA Foundation's donation efforts.** **"Every drop joins the river; every small effort helps the community."** Ways to donate funds: 1. Zelle Quick Pay to CCCWA Foundation, e-mail: info@ccc-wa.org 2. Online wire transfer/ACH: To: CCCWA Foundation, checking account number: 1381 2768 3476, Routing number: 125000024, Address: Bank of America, 2830 80th Ave SE, Mercer Island, WA 98040 Ways to donate supplies: Please contact any of the following task force member organizations to coordinate further: 1. items.title_en: United as One to Fight the Epidemic; A Global Community Working Together for Relief! CCCWA Member Companies Mobilize Resources Across China and the US to Combat the Outbreak!
items.title_zh: 四海同心举力抗疫；全球一体协助救援！CCCWA单位集结中美两国资源鼎力防控、奋战抗击疫情！
items.body_en:
The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) is a non-profit organization voluntarily initiated by Chinese-funded enterprises based in Washington State. The Chamber aims to provide a platform for Chinese enterprises to exchange ideas in the United States, promote trade cooperation between China and the Pacific Northwest region, and support and facilitate more Chinese enterprises in their investments and development in the U.S. At the same time, CCCWA is also committed to promoting social welfare and public benefit causes. In the past, CCCWA has featured charity sales of children's artwork at its gala dinners, with all proceeds donated to U.S. welfare organizations to support activities that help adopted Chinese-American children return to China to search for their biological parents.

In the face of the sudden outbreak of the novel coronavirus (COVID-19) epidemic, members of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State have demonstrated their corporate social responsibility across various sectors, actively coordinating with their domestic and overseas branches to procure relevant medical supplies and donate them free of charge to severely affected regions in need.

Currently, CCCWA council member companies are mobilizing resources from both China and the United States to fight the epidemic:

  • Systimmune (Baiyi Pharmaceutical) Seattle Company has been making every effort to source medical supplies in North America, having procured surgical masks, N95 masks, medical goggles, and medical protective suits. The first batch of supplies has already been delivered to designated recipient hospitals, including Sichuan Provincial People's Hospital, West China Second University Hospital of Sichuan University, Chengdu Wenjiang District People's Hospital, Leshan People's Hospital, Mianyang 404 Hospital, Wuhan Children's Hospital in Hubei, and Wuhan Asia Heart Hospital.

  • Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) quickly allocated over RMB 30 million in cash to ensure the orderly operation of transportation, hospitals, and other critical services. Meanwhile, through its green channel, ICBC provided approximately RMB 1.6 billion in financing to enterprises related to epidemic prevention and control.

  • iSoftStone donated RMB 10 million to Wuhan.

  • MOMΛ (Contemporary Land) donated RMB 2 million to Wuhan and established a RMB 10 million charity fund pool.

  • Other CCCWA member companies have also provided assistance to their compatriots in China through various channels.

Though the epidemic is merciless, humanity is compassionate. With firm confidence, we stand together to fight the virus and win this battle without gunfire.
items.body_zh:
华盛顿州中国总商会（CCCWA），是由华盛顿州的中资企业自愿发起组成的非营利性组织。商会旨在为中资企业在美国的交流提供平台，促进中国和美西北地区贸易合作，支持和帮助更多的中资企业对美投资和发展。同时，CCCWA也致力推动社会公益福利事业，过去CCCWA在商会举办的晚宴中特设儿童作品义卖，将所得善款捐赠给美国相关福利机构以资助在美国生活、从小被领养的华裔儿童回到中国寻找亲生父母的活动。


面对当下突如其来的新型冠状病毒感染的肺炎疫情，华盛顿州中国总商会会员在各个领域发挥出了企业社会责任感，积极协调公司海内分支机构进行相关物资采购，并无偿捐赠给有需求的疫情严重的地区。

目前CCCWA理事会单位集结中美两国资源奋力抗击疫情：

  • 百利药业Systimmune西雅图公司，倾力在北美寻求采购途径,已筹集到医用外科口罩和N95口罩、医用护目镜、医用防护服等，第一批物资已经陆续到达定点捐赠医院(四川省人民医院、四川大学华西第二医院、成都市温江区人民医院、乐山市人民医院、绵阳404医, 湖北武汉市儿童医院和武汉亚洲心脏病医院)

  • 工商银行（ICBC）迅速调拨人民币3000多万元现金，保障交通运输、医院等有序运行，同时通过绿色通道，为疫情防控领域相关企业提供融资约16亿元.

  • 软通动力（iSoftStone) 向武汉市捐款人民币1000万元.

  • 当代置业（MOMΛ）已经向武汉捐赠人民币200万元，并设立1000万元慈善基金额度资金池.

CCCWA其他单位也已经通过各种渠道方式为国内同胞们提供帮助。
病魔无情，人间有爱，坚定信心对抗疫情，打赢这场没有硝烟的战争。

items.title_en: Standing Together Against the Epidemic, United in Overcoming Hardship

items.body_en:
The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) is a nonprofit organization voluntarily founded by Chinese-funded enterprises operating in Washington State. The chamber serves as a communication platform for Chinese companies conducting business in the U.S., facilitates trade and cooperation between China and the Pacific Northwest of America, and supports Chinese firms investing and expanding their operations in the United States. Meanwhile, CCCWA is committed to advancing social welfare initiatives. At its annual galas, the chamber has hosted charity auctions featuring children’s artworks, with all proceeds donated to U.S. welfare agencies to fund programs that help Chinese-American adoptees raised in the U.S. travel back to China to reunite with their birth parents.

When the sudden COVID-19 outbreak struck, member enterprises of CCCWA demonstrated robust Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) across all industries. They coordinated their domestic and overseas branches to source medical supplies and donated them free of charge to severely affected regions in China.

At present, council member organizations of CCCWA have pooled resources from both China and the U.S. to mount a united fight against the pandemic:

  1. Systimmune Inc. (Seattle Branch) The company made every effort to secure procurement channels across North America, sourcing surgical masks, N95 respirators, medical goggles, disposable protective coveralls and other PPE. Its first batch of supplies has been delivered sequentially to designated recipient hospitals: Sichuan Provincial People’s Hospital, West China Second University Hospital, Wenjiang District People’s Hospital of Chengdu, Leshan People’s Hospital, Mianyang No.404 Hospital, Wuhan Children’s Hospital and Wuhan Asia Heart Hospital.
  2. ICBC USA Industrial and Commercial Bank of China rapidly allocated over 30 million RMB in cash to maintain the smooth operation of transportation networks and medical facilities. Via dedicated green financing channels, the bank also extended approximately 1.6 billion RMB in credit to enterprises supporting epidemic prevention and control work.
  3. iSoftStone iSoftStone donated 10 million RMB to Wuhan for pandemic relief.
  4. Modern Land (MOMΛ) Modern Land contributed 2 million RMB to Wuhan and set up a dedicated charity fund with a total reserve of 10 million RMB.

Other CCCWA member organizations have also provided assistance to communities in China through a wide range of channels.

The virus is merciless, yet humanity is boundless in compassion. Let us stand firm in our resolve to combat the coronavirus and win this all-out battle without gunpowder.

华盛顿州中国总商会（CCCWA），是由华盛顿州的中资企业自愿发起组成的非营利性组织。商会旨在为中资企业在美国的交流提供平台，促进中国和美西北地区贸易合作，支持和帮助更多的中资企业对美投资和发展。同时，CCCWA也致力推动社会公益福利事业，过去CCCWA在商会举办的晚宴中特设儿童作品义卖，将所得善款捐赠给美国相关福利机构以资助在美国生活、从小被领养的华裔儿童回到中国寻找亲生父母的活动。
面对当下突如其来的新型冠状病毒感染的肺炎疫情，华盛顿州中国总商会会员在各个领域发挥出了企业社会责任感，积极协调公司海内分支机构进行相关物资采购，并无偿捐赠给有需求的疫情严重的地区。

目前CCCWA理事会单位集结中美两国资源奋力抗击疫情：

  • 百利药业Systimmune西雅图公司，倾力在北美寻求采购途径,已筹集到医用外科口罩和N95口罩、医用护目镜、医用防护服等，第一批物资已经陆续到达定点捐赠医院(四川省人民医院、四川大学华西第二医院、成都市温江区人民医院、乐山市人民医院、绵阳404医, 湖北武汉市儿童医院和武汉亚洲心脏病医院)

  • 工商银行（ICBC）迅速调拨人民币3000多万元现金，保障交通运输、医院等有序运行，同时通过绿色通道，为疫情防控领域相关企业提供融资约16亿元.

  • 软通动力（iSoftStone) 向武汉市捐款人民币1000万元.

  • 当代置业（MOMΛ）已经向武汉捐赠人民币200万元，并设立1000万元慈善基金额度资金池.

CCCWA其他单位也已经通过各种渠道方式为国内同胞们提供帮助。
病魔无情，人间有爱，坚定信心对抗疫情，打赢这场没有硝烟的战争。

items.title_en: CCCWA Delegation Attends China-US Agricultural Resources Matchmaking Forum in California
items.title_zh: CCCWA代表团赴加州参加中美农业资源对接论坛活动
items.body_en:
On November 19, 2019, the CCCWA (China Chamber of Commerce in Washington State) delegation participated in the China-US Agricultural Resources Matchmaking and Food Safety Policy Exchange Forum in Sacramento, jointly hosted by the Chinese Consulate-General in San Francisco, the California Governor's Office of Business and Economic Development, and the City of Sacramento. The forum aimed to strengthen the exchange of food safety experience and policy between California and China, promote trade exchange in agricultural products between California and China, and build a bridge for people-to-people exchange between California and China. Commercial Counselor Yang Yihang of the Chinese Consulate-General in San Francisco attended the forum. The Director of the California Department of Food and Agriculture, a California State Assembly member, and a Senior Advisor for International Affairs and Trade at the Governor's Office of Business and Economic Development (GO-Biz) introduced the state of California's agricultural development and California-China agricultural trade. Dr. Wang, a food safety policy expert at UC Davis, was invited to introduce California's food safety policies and their implementation. The exchange forum also featured business matchmaking activities between major California agricultural producers and Chinese-invested enterprises. After the forum concluded, the delegation was invited to visit local companies for on-site inspections. items.title_en: Choices for High Schoolers Taking College Courses: How Running Start Compares to AP/IB in Selecting Washington State's Top High Schoolers to Advance Directly to College
items.title_zh: 高中生学习大学课程的选择：与AP/IB 相比较，Running Start项目如何选拔华盛顿州优秀的高中生跳级直入大学.
items.summary_en: Recently, CCCWA invited special guest Mr. Lei He, Assistant Director of International Education at Bellevue College, to introduce the community to one option for local high schoolers to take college courses: the Running Start program.
items.summary_zh: 近期， CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会特邀嘉宾Bellevue College 国际教育部主管 Mr Lei He ( Assistant Director of International Education from Bellevue College)...
items.body_en:
Recently, CCCWA invited special guest Mr. Lei He, Assistant Director of International Education at Bellevue College, to introduce the community to one option for local high schoolers to take college courses: the Running Start program.

The Running Start program began in 1990, led by the Washington State government with assistance from the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, with the goal of selecting outstanding Washington State high schoolers to advance directly into college. In the Running Start program, full-time participating students no longer take high school classes, instead using college courses to fulfill the equivalent high school requirements. Second, full-time participants can enter college at age 16 and graduate with a bachelor's degree by age 20, saving 1–2 years of study time. Third, participants in Running Start pay no college tuition, saving 1–2 years of college costs. Fourth, students who complete the program can enter directly as juniors, which carries a relatively higher acceptance rate than applying as a freshman. Over the past 30 years, the Running Start program has continued to grow — at Bellevue College alone, there are now more than 2,500 Running Start students enrolled, mostly from local Eastside high schools, cultivating a large pool of outstanding talent for Washington State.
items.body_zh:
近期， CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会特邀嘉宾Bellevue College 国际教育部主管 Mr Lei He (Assistant Director of International Education from Bellevue College) 为社区介绍本地高中生学习大学课程的选择项目之一：Running Start.

Running Start项目始于1990年，由华盛顿州政府主持、比尔盖茨基金会协助，目的是选拔华州优秀的高中生跳级直入大学. 参加Running Start项目，如果是全日制，学生就不再上高中课程，而是以大学课程抵相应的高中课程；2是全日制参与的学生完全可以做到16岁入大学，20岁本科毕业，节省学生1-2年的学习时间；3是参与Running Start项目，学生无需支付大学学费，节省1-2年大学费用；4是学生完成学习直入大三，比申请大一录取率相对高。30年以来，Running Start项目规模不断扩大，现在仅在贝尔维学院，就有超过2,500名Running Start项目学生就读，主要来自本地东区(East Side)的高中学生，为华州培养了大批优秀人才.

items.title_en: CCCWA Council Member Seattle Real Estate Investment Club Celebrates Its 4th Anniversary
items.title_zh: CCCWA理事单位西雅图地产投资俱乐部成立四周年庆典
items.body_en: CCCWA CCCWA _November 1, 2019, 06:50_ On October 26, 2019, the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club — a CCCWA council member organization — held a celebration marking its 4th anniversary. In addition to numerous club members, guests at the celebration included friends from the Washington State China Chamber of Commerce (CCCWA), the 808 Golf Club, the Seattle Entrepreneurs Club, and other associations and organizations. The Seattle Real Estate Investment Club was founded in 2015 as a nonprofit organization registered in Washington State. Its membership consists of real estate investors, development and management companies, design firms, attorneys, accountants, real estate brokers, and other professionals across the real estate industry's supply chain. In the four years since its founding, members have voluntarily teamed up on the club's platform to successfully invest in a number of commercial real estate projects. The celebration was co-hosted by rotating club chairs Ms. Li Xiaoyan and Ms. Zhang Xiaohong. During the event, several members shared the achievements and lessons they had gained over the past year. The Seattle Real Estate Investment Club is also actively engaged in community charitable work; at the celebration, attorney Cai Qing introduced the Eastside Arts Center charitable project. The celebration proceeded in a warm and friendly atmosphere, with attendees expressing how much they enjoyed the opportunity — and how grateful they were — to make new friends and business partners through the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club's 4th anniversary. All extended their wishes for continued success for both the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club and the Washington State China Chamber of Commerce (CCCWA), and for their continued delivery of quality support and service to members.
items.body_zh:
CCCWA CCCWA 

2019 年 10 月 26 日， CCCWA理事单位西雅图地产投资俱乐部举行了成立四周年庆典活动。参加此次庆典活动的嘉宾除了众多俱乐部会员以外，还有来自华盛顿州中国总商会（ CCCWA ），808 高尔夫球俱乐部，西雅图创业协会等协会和单位的会员朋友们。

西雅图房地产俱乐部成立于 2015年，是在华盛顿州注册成立的非盈利机构；其会员由房地产投资人、开发管理公司、设计公司、律师、会计师、房地产经纪人以及地产专业上下游从业人士组成。俱乐部成立四年以来，会员们已经在其平台上自愿组合，成功投资了多个商业地产项目。

西雅图地产投资俱乐部轮值主席李晓艳女士、张小红女士共同主持此次庆典。庆典活动过程中，多位会员分享了在过去一年中取得的成就和收获的心得。

西雅图房地产投资俱乐部还积极参与社区公益事业，庆典当日蔡清律师介绍了东区艺术中心公益项目。

整场庆典活动在友好和热烈的气氛下进行，参与庆典的嘉宾们纷纷表示很享受也很感谢能够通过西雅图房地产投资俱乐部成立四周年这个契机结交到新朋友和商业合作伙伴。共同祝愿西雅图房地产投资俱乐部和华盛顿州中国总商会（CCCWA ）协会平台越办越好，为会员朋友们持续提供优质帮助与服务。

items.title_en: Notice on the China-Funded Enterprises and California Agricultural Resources Matchmaking Conference and California Food Safety Policy Exchange
items.title_zh: 关于举办中资企业与加州农业资源对接会暨加州食品安全政策交流会的通知
items.body_en: San Francisco Business Bulletin San Francisco Business Bulletin _October 29, 2019, 10:53_ To all relevant China-funded enterprises: In order to further serve China-funded enterprises, help them connect with agricultural resources in California, and promote local-city cooperation and agricultural trade between China and the United States, the Economic and Commercial Office of the Chinese Consulate-General in San Francisco will co-host, together with the Governor's Office of Business and Economic Development (GoBiz) and the government of Sacramento — California's state capital — a matchmaking conference between China-funded enterprises and California agricultural resources, alongside a California food safety policy exchange. The event will feature the Secretary of the California Department of Food and Agriculture, members of the California State Legislature, and a senior advisor for international affairs and trade at GoBiz, who will introduce California's agricultural development and China-California agricultural trade. Experts from the University of California, Davis will also present on California's food safety policies and their implementation. The event will arrange business matchmaking between major California agricultural producers and China-funded enterprises, and will organize site visits for China-funded enterprises to relevant local companies. China-funded enterprises with an interest in attending — including but not limited to those in agriculture, food and beverage, and e-commerce — are welcome to join. Details are as follows: **Time:** November 19, 2019. **Location:** California State Capitol (10th and L Streets, State Capitol, Sacramento, CA 95814). **Registration:** Please submit the following to the Economic and Commercial Office by November 8: 1. Attendee information (title, name, contact details, etc.); 2. An English-language company profile (1–2 pages). **Contact:** Wang Han, Deputy Consul, Economic and Commercial Office of the Consulate-General. Email: wanghan@mofcom.gov.cn. Phone: (415) 852-5975. Economic and Commercial Office, Chinese Consulate-General in San Francisco. October 22, 2019

items.body_en: Speaker: Milissa Ormiston, Business Development Manager, Frist American Exchange Company · What is a 1031 Exchange and what are the requirements and qualifications? · Who is considered a qualified intermediary? · Property identification rules · How vesting should be held and related party issues · Reverse and improvement type exchanges · What to expect regarding closing costs related to a 1031 exchange · Lesser known exchange alternatives - Delaware Statutory Trust, IRC Section 121 and vacation homes; and examples of how to apply them Everyone enthusiastically attended the seminar that day.
items.body_zh:

当日大家踊跃参加了这次讲座。

items.title_en: Seattle | In the Face of Market Turmoil, How Do We Hedge Risk?
items.title_zh: 西雅图 | 市场动荡面前，我们如何对冲风险？
items.body_en:
Maxim North America Maxim North America _September 12, 2019 06:44_ - This article is for informational exchange only and does not constitute any transaction advice. - A lecture by CCCWA member organization "Maxim Financial." 2019 was undoubtedly a turbulent year for the global economy. Trade disputes between regions intensified, and the IMF once again lowered its forecast for this year's world economic growth in its latest report. Affected by the inversion of short- and long-term bond yields and the U.S.-China trade dispute, U.S. stocks in August just experienced their largest monthly decline of the year. Facing a possible impending global economic downturn, everyone faces a severe test: **How do you protect your assets amid market turmoil?** 01 The TINA Effect. TINA is the abbreviation for **"There is no alternative,"** meaning **"there is no better choice."** In today's investment field, TINA is often used to describe investors' **"less-than-ideal asset allocation"**—meaning that when investors cannot find quality investment targets, they have to put their money into certain assets because other targets perform even worse. The resulting **TINA effect** occurs when enough people in the market hold a similar mindset and large amounts of capital pour into a few investment targets, ultimately driving those targets up without any other support. This July, although various U.S. economic indicators were falling, the S&P 500 index rose against the current, at one point reaching a historic high of **3,000 points.** Such gains seemed exciting, yet nearly **19% of the rise** was supported by just four tech stocks: Facebook, Microsoft, Apple, and Amazon. This shows that **the market's capital could not find other more attractive products and could only keep concentrating funds into these four stocks;** the TINA effect ultimately drove up their prices. For ordinary individual investors, the stocks of the four big tech companies might still be a passable choice. But for employees working at tech companies, such asset allocation is clearly **too concentrated,** and they urgently need other investment targets to **diversify risk.** 02 Allocate alternative assets to effectively diversify risk. **Risk management** has always been a key focus for institutional investors. The more they face a turbulent market, the more cautious institutional investors with trillions of dollars become. Recently, they have put more attention on risk control in **asset allocation,** trying to minimize possible losses. To effectively diversify risk, in their asset allocation—besides the stocks and bonds familiar to individual investors—**alternative investment** plays an indispensable role. Alternative assets come in many kinds, covering different industries and investment vehicles, including **private equity funds, hedge funds,** and **real estate funds.** Compared with traditional assets, alternative assets can usually bring investors excess returns under **superior professional investment decisions** and **risk management.** The market has proven that alternative assets can provide **long-term stable returns** and **effective risk diversification.** **So—what kind of alternative investment is suitable for individual investors? How can individuals invest in alternative assets?** CCCWA member organization "Maxim Financial" will present a two-day lecture on alternative investment on September 12 and 13, 2019. You will learn:

- How to correctly understand

**risk exposure** and reduce volatility in asset returns?

- In

**asset allocation,** how can small individual investors **learn from institutional investors**?

- What is alternative investment, and what are the benefits of allocating to it?
- Hedging weapons for a down market—

**distressed debt** & **life settlements.** **Lecture Times:** Wednesday, September 11, 6:30-8:30 pm; Thursday, September 12, 6:30-8:30 pm. **Lecture Location:** 325 118th Avenue Southeast, Suite 208, Bellevue, WA 98005. **Registration:** Scroll to the end, click **Read Original,** and register on Eventbrite: bit.ly/mxinvest, or scan the QR code below and **reply "Seattle" to register for the lecture.** Maxim Financial, based on internet platform technology, connects with **high-quality global asset management firms** to bring alternative investment opportunities—once available only to institutions—to individual investors, helping them achieve **diversified** asset allocation. Maxim Financial's **core team members** all previously served at major global financial institutions such as UBS, Merrill Lynch, Barclays, Deutsche Bank, and Partners Capital. As of 2018, more than **1,000 active qualified investors** had made alternative asset allocations through Maxim Financial, with cumulative transaction volume exceeding **$150 million.** **▼ Related Product Introduction ▼** DMG South Carolina Student Apartment Development Fund · LSAF Life Settlement Fund · B-REIT Blackstone Real Estate Investment Trust. **Follow us to unlock more investment information. Maxim Financial offers free customized financial investment knowledge lectures on an ongoing basis. If your company or organization has investment guidance needs, you're welcome to message "lecture cooperation" on our official account or contact our WeChat customer service.** For details, see the reference links: https://www.nytimes.com/2019/07/11/business/stock-market-record.html https://www.wsj.com/articles/tech-rally-powers-record-gains-for-stocks-11563701401 https://www.ft.com/content/364e380a-277c-11e4-be5a-00144feabdc0 https://www.investopedia.com/terms/t/tina-there-no-alternative.asp **CCCWA**

CCCWA会员单位“美信金融”讲座

> 2019年无疑是全球经济形势动荡的一年。地区之间的贸易争端愈演愈烈、世界银行（IMF）在最新的报告中再次下调对今年世界经济增长的预期。>> 受到长短期债券收益率倒挂、中美贸易争端影响，8月的美股刚刚经历今年以来最大月度跌幅。>> 面对可能即将发生的全球经济下行周期，每一个人都在面临着严峻的考验： **如何在市场动荡中守护住自己的资产？**

01

TINA效应

TINA是 **“There is no alternative”** 的缩写，翻译成中文指的是 **“没有更好的选择”**。

在今天的投资领域，TINA常常被用来形容投资者 **“不够理想的资产配置”**，意思是：当投资人无法找到优质的投资标的时，不得不将资金投入于一些资产中，因为其他的投资标的表现更差。

而由此引发的 **TINA效应**， 即是当市场上有足够多的人都保持着类似的心态时，大量资金涌入少数投资标的，最终导致该标的在没有其他助推的情况下上涨。

今年7月，尽管美国的各项经济数据都在下跌，标准普尔500指数却逆流而上，一度站上 **3000点** 的历史高位。这样的涨幅看似振奋人心，然而其中有近**19%的上涨** 都是靠Facebook、Microsoft、苹果和Amazon这四支科技股支撑起来的。

这表明， **市场上的资金找不到其他更吸引人的商品，只能将资金不断集中地投入这四支股票之中**，TINA效应最终推高了他们的价格。

对于普通个人投资者来说，四大科技公司的股票或许仍旧是一个还过得去的选择。

但对于就职于科技公司的员工来说，这样的资产配置显然 **过于集中**， 急需其他投资标的以 **分散风险**。

02

配置另类资产，有效分散风险

**风险管控**，一直是机构投资者的关注重点。

越是面对震荡的市场，拥有上万亿美金的机构投资者就越谨慎。近一段时间以来，他们将更多的注意力放在 **资产配置**的风险控管上，试图把有可能的损失降到最低。

为了有效分散风险，在他们的资产配置中，除了个人投资者所熟悉的股票和债券以外， **另类投资（Alternative Investment**）更是不可或缺的角色。

另类资产种类繁多，涵盖不同产业及投资工具，类型包括 **私募基金**， **对冲基金**， **房地产基金** 等。

与传统资产相比，另类资产通常可以在 **更优的专业投资决策** 和 **风险管理** 下，为投资人带来超额回报。 市场证明，另类资产可以提供**长期稳定收益** 和 有效风险分散 **。**

**那么——**

**什么样的另类投资适合个人投资者？**

**个人如何投资另类资产？**

items.title_en: Dance Drama "The Butterfly Lovers" (Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai)
items.title_zh: 舞劇《梁山伯與祝英台》
items.body_en: CCCWA CCCWA _August 21, 2019 10:04_ On the occasion of the 40th anniversary of the establishment of U.S.-China diplomatic relations, the American Asian Performing Arts Theatre (AAPAT), the Beijing Dance Academy, and the Seattle Huaxing Arts Troupe will jointly present a dance drama adapted from "The Butterfly Lovers" (Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai), one of China's four great folk love legends. Li Hengda, director of the Seattle Huaxing Arts Troupe and artistic director of AAPAT, was invited by the Beijing Dance Academy to serve as screenwriter and chief director to complete the creation of the dance drama "The Butterfly Lovers" for the academy. This dance drama is a National Arts Fund project and won 5 major awards at the 2019 Beijing Dance Competition. This golden autumn, the dance drama "The Butterfly Lovers" will bring its honors and its mission of promoting Chinese culture and art to three performances at McCaw Hall in Seattle on September 5, 6, and 7. To promote Chinese culture and art and bring together everyone's passion for the arts, CCCWA (the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State) is honored to serve as the designated promotional platform for this event. Everyone is welcome to purchase tickets—click the link: https://www.ticketmaster.com/search?q=The+Butterfly+Lovers+-+Liang+Zhu or visit www.asianperformingarts.org for details; you may also call AAPAT directly to reserve: 425.830.8054 (Serena). Group tickets of ten or more receive a 10% discount.

CCCWA CCCWA 

中美建交 40 週年之際，美國亞洲表演藝術劇院（American Asian Performing Arts Theatre,AAPAT），北京舞蹈學院，西雅圖華星藝術團將聯合推出根據中國四大民間愛情故事傳說之一的《梁山伯與祝英台》編創的舞劇。西雅圖華星藝術團團長，和亞洲表演藝術劇院藝術總監李恆達得到北京舞蹈學院的邀 請，作為編劇和總導演為北京舞蹈學院完成了舞劇《梁山伯與祝英台》的創作。這部舞劇是國家藝術基金項目，並在 2019 年北京舞蹈比賽中榮獲 5 項大 獎。今年金秋時節，舞劇《梁祝》將帶著榮耀，帶著弘揚中國文化藝術的使命 將 於9 月 5，6，7 日在西雅圖 McCaw Hall 表演三場。

items.title_en: CCCWA Invites US Professionals to Break Down the '1031 Tax-Deferred Exchange' Every Real Estate Buyer/Seller Should Know
items.title_zh: CCCWA特邀美国专业人士解析房地产买卖过程中须知的“1031税务递延交换”
items.summary_en: When buying or selling property, the '1031 tax-deferred exchange' is a tax strategy the IRS allows taxpayers to use to legally defer taxes.
items.summary_zh: 买卖物业时，“1031 税务递延交换”是国税局允许纳税人合法避税的一种税务策略...
items.body_en:
When buying or selling property, the '1031 tax-deferred exchange' is a tax strategy the IRS allows taxpayers to use to legally defer taxes. '1031' is a tax policy with major implications for investment returns — effectively like borrowing interest-free funds from the government to invest in real estate, a form of leverage.

The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA), together with the Seattle Real Estate Club, recently invited an expert from First American to give a lecture on the 1031 exchange, a powerful real estate tax-saving tool.

Speaker: Milissa Ormiston, Business Development Manager, First American Exchange Company

Topics included:
- What is a 1031 Exchange and what are the requirements and qualifications?
- Who is considered a qualified intermediary?
- Property identification rules
- How vesting should be held and related party issues
- Reverse and improvement type exchanges
- What to expect regarding closing costs related to a 1031 exchange
- Lesser known exchange alternatives — Delaware Statutory Trust, IRC Section 121, and vacation homes — and examples of how to apply them

Attendees enthusiastically participated in this lecture.

items.title_en: A Seminar on the "1031 Tax-Deferred Exchange," a Must-Know Real Estate Tax-Saving Tool in U.S. Property Transactions
items.title_zh: 美国房地产买卖中必须懂得的有关房地产省税利器“1031税务递延交换”的讲座
items.body_en:
When buying and selling property, the 1031 tax-deferred exchange is a tax strategy the IRS allows taxpayers to use to legally defer taxes. To become a successful real estate investor, you must know how to make good use of leverage in property investment. In other words, use as little of your own capital as possible and make more use of bank loans—an investment approach that does more with less—and use the "1031" tax code to defer taxes, much like borrowing the government's interest-free funds to invest in real estate, which is itself a form of leverage. The Seattle Real Estate Club, together with the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State, will soon invite an expert from First American to give a seminar on the 1031 exchange, a powerful real estate tax-saving tool. Speaker: Milissa Ormiston, Business Development Manager, First American Exchange Company. Topics include: · What is a 1031 Exchange and what are the requirements and qualifications? · Who is considered a qualified intermediary? · Property identification rules · How vesting should be held and related party issues · Reverse and improvement type exchanges · What to expect regarding closing costs related to a 1031 exchange · Lesser known exchange alternatives - Delaware Statutory Trust, IRC Section 121 and vacation homes; and examples of how to apply them. The 1031 is a tax policy that greatly affects investment returns—everyone is welcome to attend this seminar. Free for members of the Seattle Real Estate Club and the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State (members register free at: info@ccc-wa.org). Public registration fee: $30 (snacks, fruit, and drinks provided). **CCCWA**

_June 8, 2019 05:20_

items.body_en: Consul General Wang dong Hua; Economic & Counselor Yang Yi Hang from Chinese Consulate in San Francisco; Lieutenant Governor Cyrus Habib of Washington State;, Director of International Relations and Protocol Schuyler Hoss, State of Washington; Mayor of Bellevue John Chelminiak; Economic and Trade Director Carlton Vann, City of Seattle; Former Governor of Washington State, Former Commercial minister of Federal Government, Former US ambassador to China, Gary Locke;, CEO Marilyn Strickland of Seattle Metropolitan Chamber of Commerce, and approximately 100 guests who are political, business and community representatives from the greater Seattle region attended the banquet. The President of Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington state, Ms. Cathy Zhou was the host of the banquet。Consul General Wang Dong Hua gave the keynote, he had made strong and firm comment on the relation and recent economic and trade development between the two nations. The remark of Lieutenant Governor Habib highly confirmed the importance that Washington state attached to China-US relation, and its endeavor which is full of promising prospects. Consul General Wang Dong Hua emphases that, Washington state is a close partner of China. For many years, both sides carried out continuous and deep exchange in the areas of economy, trade and culture. Microsoft, Boeing, Starbucks, Amazon, Costco are stationed in Washington state, they accelerated the growth and expansion of the economy of Washington state. Next year would be the 40th anniversary of China & US established diplomatic relation, under current background, China and Washington state should keep close partner relationship, to maintain and continue develop relations further. Habib also stressed the close relation between Washington state and China：for many years, the trade volume of Washington State to China always ranked as the top among all US states. Although we are facing current rigorous challenge, but Washington state government would continue to dedicate to promote the province-state cooperation between China and US. During the interview, Consul General Wang Dong Hua expressed that, during this trip, five members of consulate general, and over 20 entrepreneurs from various industries of California State came to Seattle. Besides visiting famous enterprises of Washington State, they are looking for new opportunities to better enhance the exchange and cooperation in various fields between China and US. BellevueMayor Mr. Chelmeniak, City of Bellevue and Former Mayor of Tacoma, Present of Seattle Metropolitan Chamber of Commerce, Ms. Strickland both expressed their warm welcome on Chinese enterprises to strengthen the exchange with various cities of Washington state, and expected more deep cooperation. Political, business and community representatives from the greater Seattle region attended the banquet.

items.title_zh: 华盛顿州中国总商会“西雅图大讲坛”第18期：人工智能法律和道德问题研究
items.summary_en: Recently, Ron Cai, Partner-in-Charge at the Shanghai office of Davis Wright Tremaine LLP, hosted a CCCWA workshop on legal issues in artificial intelligence.
items.summary_zh: ​日前,美国戴维斯.莱特.特里梅因律师事务所上海代表处主任律师，蔡荣伟主持CCCWA“西雅图大讲坛”...
items.body_en:
Recently, Ron Cai, Partner-in-Charge at the Shanghai office of Davis Wright Tremaine LLP, hosted a CCCWA 'Seattle Lecture Series' workshop, sharing on 'Legal Issues in Artificial Intelligence.'

The content included: Legal Issues in Artificial Intelligence — Industry/Profession Regulation, Joint Development, Privacy & Security, Potential Legal Liabilities, Bias & Discrimination; and Ethical Issues in Artificial Intelligence — Unemployment, Inequality, Humanity, Robot Rights, Control.

Mr. Cai focused on the impact of AI development on various industries, analyzed several cases provided by attendees, and addressed their questions and concerns on the spot. The workshop was well received.

Attendees expressed hope that CCCWA would continue to organize workshops on a wide range of specialized topics so the Chinese business community could share knowledge and keep pace with industry trends. CCCWA's efforts in serving the community were highly appreciated and recognized by attendees.

items.title_en: 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics Image Ambassador and International Paralympic Committee Image Ambassador Hou Bin's Keynote Speech: Carrying Forward the Olympic Spirit, Overcoming Yourself Through Unwavering Perseverance, and Pursuing Your Dreams to Achieve Success
items.title_zh: 2022年北京冬奥会形象大使、国际残奥委会形象大使侯斌先生主题演讲：弘扬奥运精神，坚定毅力超越自我，追求梦想挑战成功
items.summary_en: Recently, three-time World Paralympic Games men's high jump champion and 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics Image Ambassador Hou Bin attended the CCCWA Seattle Lecture Series, delivering a keynote speech on carrying forward the Olympic spirit and pursuing dreams through perseverance.
items.summary_zh: 近日，世界残奥会三届男子跳高冠军、2022年北京冬奥会形象大使侯斌出席CCCWA西雅图大讲坛，带来“弘扬奥运精神，坚定毅力超越自我，追求梦想挑战成功”的主题演讲。...
items.body_en:
Recently, CCCWA's workshop series featured Mr. Hou Bin's public speech on 'Carry Forward the Olympic Spirit, Pursue Dreams and Ambitions.' Mr. Hou is a three-time World Paralympic Games men's high jump champion and the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics Image Ambassador.

Hou Bin shared the story of his journey: at the age of 9, he lost his left leg in an accident, but the hardship of growing up never dimmed his hopes for the future. At the age of 21, he became a Paralympian, representing China at the 1996 Summer Paralympics in Atlanta and winning the gold medal in high jump with a record of 1.92 meters. He went on to defend his title at both the 2000 and 2004 Paralympic Games. During the opening ceremony of the 2008 Beijing Summer Paralympics, Hou Bin served as the final torchbearer, lighting the Paralympic cauldron by pulling himself up a rope while secured to his wheelchair bracket. Hou Bin said: 'People have to keep striving to surpass themselves — all technology, ideas, the future, and life itself are created, not waited for. We should live with hope and dreams in our hearts. Don't let anyone steal your dream — where there is a dream, there is a future.' (Quoted from a report by The China Press.)

Since retiring, Hou has become a motivational speaker. In 2013, he launched 'Stand Up Again,' a fundraising project for children needing prosthetic limbs after the Ya'an and Wenchuan earthquakes.

Hou Bin's story moved and inspired everyone in attendance. The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State hoped that, through this speech, local Chinese community members would come away with something meaningful, while also bringing the community closer together. After the speech, CCCWA presented Hou Bin with the 'CCCWA Social Responsibility Award.'

Hou Bin's story of perseverance was full of positive energy, inspiring everyone in attendance.
items.body_zh:
近日，世界残奥会三届男子跳高冠军、2022年北京冬奥会形象大使侯斌出席CCCWA西雅图大讲坛，带来“弘扬奥运精神，坚定毅力超越自我，追求梦想挑战成功”的主题演讲。 Recently, CCCWA workshop series featured Mr. Hou Bin’s public speech on “Carry Forward the Olympic Spirit, Pursue Dreams and Ambitions". Mr. Hou is the three-time winner of the World Paralympic Games men's high jump champion and the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympic Games Image Ambassador.

侯斌讲述他的奋足迹：9岁那年的一场意外让侯斌失去了左腿，但成长的艰辛并没有磨灭侯斌对未来的憧憬。1996年，只有21岁的侯斌在亚特兰大残奥会上，以1米92的成绩打破世界纪录，获得男子跳高金牌，此后侯斌在2000年和2004年的两届残奥中卫冕，2008年北京夏季残奥会开幕中，侯斌通过拉拽绳索自行攀爬的方式点燃了残奥会的主火炬。侯斌这样说“人就是要不断去超越，所有的科技、思想、未来、人生都是创造出来而不是等待出来的。我们要活在希望和梦想当中，不要让人偷走你的梦, 有梦想，就有未来。” 引自“侨报”报导 Hou Bing shared his footprint of endeavor: at the age of 9, he lost his left leg due to an accident, however he’d never given up the hope of future despite of the hardship. At the age of 21, he became a Paralympian, and represented China at the 1996 Summer Paralympics in Atlanta and won the gold medal of high jump with the record of 1.92 meters. In 2008, Hou Bin became the first International Paralympic ambassador launched by the International Paralympic Committee. Since then, Hou Bin defended his title at both year 2000 and 2004 Paralympic Games. During the opening ceremony of year 2008 Beijing summer Paralympics' Games, Hou Bin served as Beijing Paralympic Main Torch hand. He lit up the main torch of Paralympic Games by of placing the torch in the wheelchair special bracket and tightening himself to the rope, pulling the rope and climbing up. Hou Bin said: "People have to keep striving and excel. Future and life can be created but waiting. We should live a life with hope and dream in our heart. If there is a dream, there is a future”. The story of Hou Bin’s endeavor is full of aspiration.

自退役以来，侯已成为一名励志演说家，并于2013年推出了“Stand Up Again”，这是一项针对雅安和汶川地震后需要修复截肢的受伤儿童的筹款项目。 Since retirement, Hou has become a motivational speaker. In 2013, he launched "Stand Up Again," a fundraising project for injured children who needed prosthetics after the [Ya'an](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2013_Lushan_earthquake) and [Wenchuan earthquakes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2008_Sichuan_earthquake).

侯斌与大家分享他的故事鼓舞人心, 华盛顿州中国总商会希望通过这次的演讲让本地的华人们能有所收获，同时希望能通过这样的方式凝聚本地的华人社区。演讲结束后，华盛顿州中国总商会给侯斌颁发了“CCCWA社会责任贡献奖”。 The speech was extremely well received and appreciated. Chinese community thanks Mr. Hou’s sharing his story with Chinese community during his family vacation in Seattle. CCCWA hopes the speech will inspire us and through the event to unite the local Chinese community.". After the speech,Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State, presented Hou Bin with the “Excellent Social Responsibility Award”.

侯斌的奋斗故事充满着正能量，激发斗志，大家备受鼓舞。 The story of Hou Bin’s endeavor is full of positive energy, and inspired us to persevere with our goals.

items.title_zh: 西雅图大讲坛第十六期：中国企业海外投资
items.body_en: CCCWA CCCWA _June 20, 2018 04:57_ CCCWA invites FDI research expert Professor Dr. Chen Taotao from Tsinghua University to share her insights on Chinese companies investing abroad, especially in the US. Dr. Chen is a professor at the School of Economics & Management, Tsinghua University. Her main research areas are "Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)," "International Business," and "Globalization and Strategy." She has published more than 30 papers on the topics of FDI spillover and Chinese companies investing abroad, and has presided over research projects supported by the National Science Foundation, the Ministry of Education, and the Ministry of Commerce, among others. In recent years, Prof. Chen Taotao has put more effort into topics such as Chinese companies investing in the US, the business environment in the US and Latin America, and the capability of young Chinese MNCs. During her research, Professor Chen has visited US think tanks and universities such as the Heritage Foundation and Georgetown University, as well as more than 30 branches of Chinese companies that have invested in the US and Latin American countries. She has also been invited to attend international forums, such as the World Economic Forum and Emerging Market Forums, giving speeches and engaging in various debates. ### DATE AND TIME ### Fri, June 29, 2018 ### 9:00 AM – 11:00 AM PDT ### LOCATION ### iSoftStone ### 5808 Lake Washington Boulevard Northeast ### #400 ### Kirkland, WA 98033

items.title_en: Delegation from the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade Visits Seattle
items.title_zh: 中国国际贸易促进会代表来访西雅图
items.body_en: Recently, China Council for the Promotion of International Trade (CCPIT)US delegation team came to Seattle and paid a visit to Mr. Schuyler Hoss, the director of International Relations and Protocol, State of Washington.The CCPIT delegation also met and discussed with members of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) on Chinese companies' business development in greater Seattle region. The representatives of the CCPIT discussed and learned the business scope, challenges of facing and the future development of various businesses. CCPIT committed to try its best to expand its overseas networks and to provide more effective services to all Chinese community. Seattle has close ties with China, China is also the largest export market of Washington state. As the largest export state to China, its manufacturing, hi-tech and agriculture are ranking top throughout the nation. In the past two years, Seattle, as the center of Cloud Computing, aviation, great health and new technology industries has attracted many IT high-tech talents. It has become a new force which drives regional economy in many aspects such as real estate, medical, business, manufacture, travel, education, and culture exchange. Seattle is an important hub connecting China and US economy. CCCWA welcomes CCTIP to facilitate and promote the cooperation and partnership between Chinese and the US companies.

items.title_en: CCCWA 'Seattle Lecture Series' Episode 12: How the 2018 New US Tax Law Dramatically Incentivizes Investors to Use LLCs for Real Estate Investment
items.title_zh: 华盛顿州中国总商会 “西雅图大讲坛”---第12期 :        2018年美国新税法如何极大地刺激投资人使用LLC进行房地产投资
items.summary_en: Recently, CCCWA legal advisor Mr. Alex Cai (an international business attorney with over 20 years of experience practicing in Washington State) and Mr. Moses Wan (President of M Squared Tax PLLC and adjunct tax professor at Seattle University) held a special seminar analyzing the impact of the new 2018 tax law on LLC real estate investment.
items.summary_zh: 日前, CCCWA法律顾问 Mr. Alex Cai (华盛顿州执业20多年，具有丰富 经验 的国际商务律师), 与 Mr. Moses Wan (M Squared Tax...
items.body_en:
Last week, CCCWA's legal advisor, Mr. Cai from Cai & Associates who has 20 years of legal work experience in international business transactions, and Mr. Moses Wan, President of M Squared Tax PLLC and adjunct tax professor at Seattle University, held a professional seminar at the Create World (USA) office analyzing the impact of the new 2018 tax law on LLC real estate investment.

Mr. Cai discussed how to take title to investment real estate properties, considerations in choosing a proper LLC management structure, practical issues for Chinese investors when forming LLCs, and the basic structure of an operating agreement.

Moses provided a high-level overview of the tax law changes under the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act and their impact on foreign real estate investments. He also discussed common holding structures for US real estate investments such as an LLC and a C Corporation, and the advantages and disadvantages of each structure in light of the new tax laws. He further discussed important US tax filing requirements related to foreign nationals investing in US real estate.

Both professionals provided precise data and shared practical case studies, and answered attendees' questions on the spot. All participants were inspired, and expressed hope that CCCWA would continue to organize these professional seminars so they could obtain the latest industry information. They also affirmed CCCWA's contribution to the community.

蔡律师介绍房地产投资时的持有类型、选择LLC公司投资时的适当管理结构、在成立LLC公司时应关注的实际问题、以及运营协议基本结构。 Mr. Cai discussed how to take titles to investment real estate properties, consideration in choosing proper LLC management structure, practical issues for Chinese investors when forming LLCs, and basic structure of an operating agreement.

Mr.MosesWan介绍新税法生效后的重大变化，包括对外国人投资美国不动产的影响，选择LLC公司及C-corporation公司利弊以及投资美国不动产的税务申报要求。 Moses provided a high level overview of the tax law changes under the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act and their impact on foreign real estate investments. He also discussed common holding structures for US real estate investments such as an LLC and a C Corporation and advantages and disadvantages of each structure in light of the new tax laws. Further, he discussed important US tax filing requirements related to foreign nationals investing in US real estate.

两位专业人士提供了精准的数据和实际案例的分享，并且当场解答了参会者提出的一些疑问， 参会人员受到了启发。 大家非常期待CCCWA今后继续举办各类专题讲座， 以便获得专业人士提供的最新业内信息。 同时, 大家肯定了CCCWA对服务社区的努力。 Two professionals provided accurate data, shared practical case studies with us and answered relevant questions on the spot. All participants were inspired. In addition, participates are expecting CCCWA to continue to organize these professional seminars so that them can obtain the latest information from the industry. items.summary_en: Under the new policy of Trump's administration, immigration regulations changed frequently — how could those affected adjust in time? Cao Xiaohe Law Office, a CCCWA member firm, recently gave the most cutting-edge and professional lecture on hot immigration topics.
items.summary_zh: 特朗普新政下移民政策频频改变，相关人士如何对新的政策及时做出调整？华盛顿州中国总商会会员单位曹霄鹤律师事务所近期为大家带来了最前沿，最专业的移民热点问题讲座。内容包含：...
items.body_en:
Under the new policy of Trump's administration, immigration regulations changed frequently — how could related personnel adjust to the new policies in time? The Lani Cao Law Office gave a seminar on the latest and most professional hot topics on immigration. The content included: 1. 2019 H1B employment visa: what type of profession can apply for H1B, when to contact an employer, contacting a lawyer, what changes occurred under the new regulations, and how to deal with not being selected in the H1B lottery. 2. Investment immigration: increases to the required investment amount — when this increase would occur, how much it would increase by, changes to TEA regional center regulations, and the impact on green card applications already submitted. 3. The difference between the investor/entrepreneur visa 'EB6' and EB5 investment immigration, and the difference from the L1A intracompany executive transfer visa.

All participants of this seminar expressed that they had benefited a lot from attending the lecture on how to plan for visa applications, and expected CCCWA to host more such lectures to promote professional knowledge of specific policy changes around investment and employment visas.

items.title_en: 2018 Chinese New Year Gala Highlights
items.title_zh: 2018年华人新春晚会精彩回顾
items.summary_en: Hundreds of members and guests gathered to celebrate the Chinese New Year with performances, a gala banquet, and award presentations.
items.summary_zh: 数百位会员和宾客欢聚一堂，共贺春节，举行文艺表演、晚会大餐和颁奖典礼。
items.body_en:
The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) welcomed the Year of the Dog with its 2018 Chinese New Year Gala — one of the organization's flagship annual events and a celebration that brought together hundreds of members, partners, and guests from across the Greater Seattle area.

The evening was a vibrant showcase of Chinese culture, community achievement, and the growing presence of Chinese-American businesses in Washington State. Held at a premier Seattle venue, the gala combined traditional celebration with modern ceremony, reflecting the dual identity of a community that bridges two cultures.

## Performances and Entertainment

The gala featured a program of cultural performances highlighting classical Chinese artistry alongside contemporary talent. Traditional Chinese dance, instrumental performances, and vocal acts drew enthusiastic applause from the assembled guests. The performances were organized to reflect the spirit of the new year — vibrant, hopeful, and celebratory.

The evening's program was carefully curated to appeal to both Chinese-speaking members and English-speaking guests, making the event an accessible introduction to Chinese cultural traditions for attendees from all backgrounds.

## Gala Banquet and Networking

A multi-course gala banquet gave members and guests the opportunity to enjoy traditional Chinese cuisine while networking with peers from across Washington State's Chinese-American business community. The banquet reflected the chamber's commitment to creating space for genuine connection — beyond formal business settings — that strengthens the bonds within the community.

The event brought together entrepreneurs, investors, legal and financial professionals, technology executives, and community leaders, creating one of the most diverse gatherings in CCCWA's calendar year.

## Award Presentations

A highlight of the gala was the annual award presentation, recognizing outstanding contributions to the CCCWA community by individual members and partner organizations. Awards acknowledged excellence across categories including business leadership, community service, cultural contribution, and support for CCCWA's mission of bridging US-China commerce and culture.

The 2018 gala marked another successful chapter in CCCWA's tradition of annual celebrations that build community pride and strengthen the organization's identity as a cornerstone of Chinese-American business life in the Pacific Northwest.
items.body_zh:
华州中华总商会（CCCWA）以2018年华人新春晚会喜迎狗年新春——这是本会年度旗舰活动之一，汇聚了来自大西雅图地区数百名会员、合作伙伴及嘉宾共襄盛举。

当晚活动生动展现了中华文化、社区成就，以及华裔美国人企业在华盛顿州日益壮大的影响力。晚会在西雅图一处顶级场馆举行，将传统庆典与现代仪式相结合，展现了这个横跨两种文化的社区所具有的双重身份特质。

## 文艺表演

晚会精心编排了一系列文艺演出，将中国古典艺术与当代才艺交相辉映。传统中国舞蹈、器乐演奏及声乐表演赢得了在场嘉宾的阵阵热烈掌声。整场演出的编排旨在展现新年的精神气象——朝气蓬勃、充满希望、喜气洋洋。

当晚的节目安排经过精心策划，既照顾到讲中文的会员，也顾及讲英语的宾客，使这场活动成为不同背景的与会者了解中华文化传统的一次亲切契机。

## 晚宴与交流联谊

多道菜式的晚宴让会员及嘉宾在品尝传统中华美食的同时，也有机会与来自华盛顿州华裔美国人商界的同行相互交流。这场晚宴体现了本会致力于在正式商务场合之外，营造真诚交流空间、强化社区凝聚力的一贯理念。

此次活动汇聚了企业家、投资人、法律与金融专业人士、科技行业高管及社区领袖，成为华州中华总商会年度活动中最具多元色彩的一场聚会。

## 颁奖典礼

晚会的一大亮点是年度颁奖典礼，旨在表彰个人会员及合作机构为华州中华总商会社区做出的杰出贡献。奖项涵盖多个类别，包括商业领导力、社区服务、文化贡献，以及对本会“架起中美商贸文化桥梁”这一使命的支持。

2018年晚会为华州中华总商会一年一度的庆典传统再添成功篇章，进一步凝聚了社区自豪感，巩固了本会作为太平洋西北地区华裔美国人商业生活重要基石的地位。

items.title_en: CCCWA 'Seattle Lecture Series' Episode 10: The Culture, History, and Appreciation of Wine
items.title_zh: 华盛顿州中国总商会“西雅图大讲坛”第10期: 葡萄酒的文化,历史和品鉴
items.summary_en: At the start of the new year, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State organized its 10th 'Seattle Lecture Series' event. Chamber member and GIYA International Chairwoman hosted a small New Year wine tasting to welcome 2018 and share wine knowledge.
items.summary_zh: 新年伊始，华盛顿州中国总商会组织举办了第十期“西雅图大讲坛”。商会会员、吉雅国际公司董事长为大家举办了迎接”2018“小型新年品酒会，分享红酒知识。...
items.body_en:
At the start of the new year, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State organized its 10th 'Seattle Lecture Series' event. Chamber member and GIYA International Chairwoman hosted a small New Year wine tasting to welcome 2018 and share wine knowledge.

Headquartered in Seattle, Washington, GIYA brought fine Washington State wines to the event, including wine served at White House state dinners. GIYA gave attendees a detailed introduction to the varieties of wine, explaining the differences between Old World and New World wines and other specialized topics. The GIYA chairwoman also shared wine etiquette, the steps of tasting, the layers of flavor in appreciation, food and wine pairing, and the practical value of wine collecting.

At the tasting, the Chamber offered attendees dry reds and whites from traditional Old World winemaking countries such as France and Italy, as well as New World countries such as the US, Australia, New Zealand, and Chile, allowing everyone to taste and compare on the spot. Guided by the professionals, attendees together explored and appreciated the differing flavors and rich qualities of Old World and New World wines.

This event was held at the lakeview offices of Chamber members iSoftStone and Vestlink. Through deep interaction during the event, attendees learned about wine while improving their quality of life, and deepened their understanding of one another as fellow members.
items.body_zh:
新年伊始，华盛顿州中国总商会组织举办了第十期“西雅图大讲坛”。商会会员、吉雅国际公司董事长为大家举办了迎接”2018“小型新年品酒会，分享红酒知识。 总部设在美国华盛顿州西雅图，吉雅国际（GIYA）带来了华盛顿州的优质佳酿，特别是美国白宫元首国宴招待用酒。 吉雅向来宾详尽介绍了葡萄酒的种类，解释了旧世界和新世界葡萄酒的区别等专业领域信息。吉雅董事长同时分享葡萄酒礼仪，品酒的步骤和品鉴的口感层次，以及酒餐搭配，红酒的收藏价值等等实用知识。

品酒会上，商会为来宾提供了法国、意大利等传统酿造国（旧世界）和美国、澳大利亚、新西兰、智利等（新世界）的干红和干白让大家现场品茗增加认知。大家在专业人士的引导下一起分享品鉴旧世界和新世界葡萄酒不同的口味、细尝浓郁的品质。

本次活动在商会会员IsoftStone、Vestlink公司的湖景办公室举行。 活动中大家进行了深层互动，学习红酒知识提高生活品质的同时，加深了会员间的相互了解。

items.body_en:
CCCWA 'Seattle Lecture Series' Episode 9: Tax-Efficient Investment Strategies in the US for High-Net-Worth Chinese Families and Businesses.

CCCWA member firm Cai & Cai Law Office invited senior planner Mr. Corbett, who specializes in estate, tax, and business succession planning, to present on personal estate tax planning for US immigrants, tax-efficient structuring for domestic real estate and business investments in the US, and family topics including multi-generational wealth transfer, and the establishment and management of charitable foundations and family offices.

Attendees from various industries reported gaining a much clearer understanding of tax planning and wealth management through the lecture, and expressed hope that CCCWA would host more similar lectures to raise awareness of financial planning topics.
items.body_zh: 华盛顿州中国总商会“西雅图大讲坛”第9期:中国高净值家庭和企业在美国高节税投资策略 华盛顿州中国总商会会员单位蔡和蔡律师事务邀请专注财产、税务和商业继承的高级规划师Mr Corbett介绍了美国移民的个人遗产税规划，在美国的不动产和企业的境内投资的节税结构的设计，以及围绕于家庭方面有关子孙及多辈之间的财富传承、慈善机构和家族办公的建立和管理。 参加活动的各行业人士纷纷表示通过聆听讲座对于如何规划节税、理财有了的了解，并期待华盛顿州中国总商会主办更多的类似讲座提高金融管理方面的认知。

items.summary_en: The full moon is rarest on the 15th but roundest on the 16th. On October 5th, the 16th day of the 8th lunar month, many CCCWA members and friends from all walks of life boarded a cruise on Lake Washington together to watch the sunset and admire the full moon.
items.summary_zh: 一年几见当头月，十五的月亮十六圆。10月5号农历八月十六，华盛顿州中国总商会的众多会员与各界人士共乘遊船泛舟华盛顿湖，观日落，赏明月。初升的皓月形如银盘，西雅图沐浴在金子般光芒下，明月与太空针的霓虹闪烁相映成辉，月湖共影，美轮美奂。总商会的会员和家人、朋友在紧张的工作之后吃月饼品佳餚，欢歌笑语，欢度一年中团圆之夜。​
items.body_en: The full moon is rarest on the 15th but roundest on the 16th. On October 5th, the 16th day of the 8th lunar month, many CCCWA members and friends from all walks of life boarded a cruise together on Lake Washington to watch the sunset and admire the full moon. The rising moon, round as a silver plate, bathed Seattle in golden light, its glow mingling beautifully with the Space Needle's shimmering lights, reflected together on the lake in a stunning scene. After a busy season of work, Chamber members and their families and friends enjoyed mooncakes and fine food together, filled with laughter and song, celebrating this night of reunion that comes but once a year.

items.body_en:
CCCWA's 'Seattle Lecture Series' lecture featuring the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) was recently held successfully. ICBC Seattle's professional team gave attendees a thorough, detailed walkthrough of ICBC's various products in the US, especially in the Seattle market, followed by in-depth discussion with guests.

ICBC has the largest customer base in China and is one of the world's Fortune Global 500 companies. Washington State, as the top US exporter to China, ranks among the leaders in manufacturing, technology, and agriculture, making it an important hub between Chinese and American enterprises. As the world's largest publicly listed company by assets and the largest bank globally by assets, ICBC's presence in Seattle provides greater convenience for more Chinese enterprises entering the market. On this occasion, ICBC gave a comprehensive introduction to its financial services and wealth management offerings.

ICBC's Banking Solutions for Cross-Border and Local Needs: Personal Accounts and Services, Company Accounts and Services, Global Cash Management, Corporate Banking: Trade Finance, Cross-Border Financing (onshore guarantee/offshore loans, cross-border M&A, etc.), Real Estate Financing (commercial real estate, construction, and land loans), and Personal Mortgage Loans.

ICBC Seattle's professional team gave attendees a thorough, detailed walkthrough of ICBC's various products in the US, especially in the Seattle market.

Attendees widely reported that they benefited greatly and expressed hope that CCCWA's 'Seattle Lecture Series' would host financial services-themed lectures more often, so they could gain comprehensive and rich financial information through expert analysis.

items.body_en:
Opening Ceremony of Seattle WASA International Art Center — 'Qi Wind, Lu Charm': An Exhibition of Contemporary Shandong Masters

On September 10th, 'Qi Wind, Lu Charm — An Exhibition of Contemporary Shandong Masters' opened at the newly established WASA International Art Center in Seattle! Attendees at the opening ceremony included Cultural Consul Xiao Xiayong of the Chinese Consulate-General in San Francisco, Wang Wei of the Shandong Provincial Publicity Department and Department of Culture, Zhang Wang, director of the Shandong Art Museum, and other artists, Bellevue City Councilmember Conrad Lee, Washington State Arts Commission Chairman Paul Manfredi, CCCWA President Honghua Zhou, Chamber advisor Attorney Cai Qing, and Eastside Art Center event chair Cathi Hatch, along with other figures from across the greater Seattle community.

WASA International Art Center is located in the beautiful city of Bellevue in the greater Seattle area. This event was an active effort to bring the 4th 'Across the Pacific — China Art Festival,' championed by Consul Xiao Xiayong of the San Francisco Consulate-General, to the Seattle area. In his remarks at the opening ceremony, Consul Xiao emphasized that Seattle already enjoys close exchange with China across trade, technology, education, and many other fields, and that cultural exchange also holds broad potential — he hoped the opening of WASA International Art Center could become a platform for a series of US-China art events in the greater Seattle area.

Bellevue Councilmember Conrad Lee remarked that multiculturalism is a defining social characteristic of the greater Seattle area, and that its inclusive, welcoming environment allows people from all over the world to live and work together in harmony.

Zhang Wang, director of the Shandong Art Museum, introduced the highlights of the exhibition, hoping it would showcase, from one perspective, the creative strength and artistic character of the Shandong painting community, and help deepen American audiences' understanding of contemporary Chinese art. The exhibition featured 40 works by contemporary Shandong artists spanning diverse subjects, rich content, and varied styles, including Shan Yinggui's 'People of Yimeng Mountain,' Kong Weike's 'Jiang Ziya Fishing,' and Pan Lusheng's 'Flowers Blooming in All Four Seasons.'

The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State congratulated WASA International Art Center and announced that the newly established CCCWA Foundation would strongly support local cultural and artistic activities as a way of giving back to the community, and also announced that the Foundation had received a generous $50,000 donation from Chamber advisor Attorney Cai Qing to support the construction of the Bellevue Eastside Art Center.
items.body_zh:
西雅图华尚国际艺术中心开业典礼-"齐风鲁韵 "- 山东当代名家精品展

9月10日，“齐风鲁韵--山东当代名家精品展”在新开张的西雅图华尚国际艺术中心开幕！中华人民共和国驻旧金山总领事馆文化参赞肖夏勇先生，山东省文化厅，山东省委宣传部王伟先生，山东美术馆馆长张望先生等艺术家， 贝尔维尔市议员李瑞麟、华盛顿州艺术委员会主席Paul Manfredi，华盛顿州中国总商会周红华会长，商会顾问蔡清律师以及Bellevue东区艺术中心活动主席Cathi Hatch 等大西雅图地区各界人士出席了开幕典礼。 WASA华尚国际艺术中心坐落在大西雅图地区的美丽城市贝尔维尤（Bellevue）。本次活动是旧金山总领事馆文化参赞肖夏勇先生倡导支持的第四届“跨越太平洋--中国艺术节”在西雅图地区推广的积极尝试。肖参赞出席开幕典礼时强调：西雅图在经贸，科技，教育等各个领域与中国已经有密切的交流， 文化互动也潜在广阔的前景，希望 WASA华尚国际艺术中心的开幕可以成为大西雅图地区中美两国艺术系列活动的平台。 贝尔维尔市议员李瑞麟先生在贺词中表示多元文化背景是大西雅图地区的社会特点，广纳海川，相互接纳的人文环境让来自世界各地人们在这里安居乐业，和谐共处。 山东美术馆馆长张望介绍了此次精品展的特色，期待通过这个展览从一个侧面展示山东中国画坛的创作实力与艺术风貌，增进美国各界对中国当代美术发展的了解和认知。展览展出了单应桂《沂蒙山人》、孔维克《姜公垂钓图》、潘鲁生《花开四时》等40幅当代山东艺术家题材多样、内涵丰富、风格各异的作品。 华盛顿州中国总商会祝贺WASA华尚国际艺术中心，并表示已成立的华盛顿州中国总商会基金会将大力支持本地区的文化艺术活动回报社区，同时宣布基金会已经获得中国总商会顾问蔡清律师的5万美金的慷慨捐助用于Bellevue东区艺术中心的建造。

On August 8th, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State invited iSoftStone Global Business Director John Peng to introduce innovative technologies for smart cities and the current state and outlook of smart city development in China and the US. Nearly 40 professionals attended this event.

The presentation covered specific areas and strategic layouts of smart city development in China and the US, including smart buildings, smart urban transportation management, environmental protection and energy efficiency, the economic and industrial development driven by smart city construction, and the impact of smart tourism on people's future lives.

Attendees actively engaged with the presenter to learn more about smart information innovation and the service experience. For more details, please see the link below:

[https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B5B1f0P8chzBbGZmZVc5UElzbGc](https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B5B1f0P8chzBbGZmZVc5UElzbGc)

items.body_en:
Celebrating the Topping-Out of Tuohong Real Estate's Bellevue Project and the Launch of Its Seattle Project

Tuohong Real Estate Development Group operates across mainland China, Hong Kong, Europe, Singapore, and North America. In 2014, Tuohong Group set its sights on the greater Seattle region. Seattle offers unique regional advantages — the shortest flight time to mainland China along with multiple nonstop routes, and strong economic momentum driven by its cutting-edge tech sector that has fueled population, employment, and income growth, all of which have drawn the attention of overseas real estate investors. Tuohong's US subsidiary is developing the Meilidu and Meili'an luxury apartment projects located right in the investment hotspots of downtown Seattle and downtown Bellevue.

Recently, Tuohong's US subsidiary held a reception in Seattle to celebrate the successful topping-out of the Meilidu apartment project and the smooth launch of the Meili'an project. At the reception, the company's president shared updates on its US development: over the past three years, Tuohong has established itself in Seattle, successfully investing in five premium real estate development projects, making it the largest Chinese real estate investment and development group in the Seattle area. As a board member and secretary-general unit of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State, Tuohong's US subsidiary actively works alongside CCCWA and other major Chinese-invested enterprises to participate in community-building activities, building a strong reputation for overseas investors and serving as a pioneer for more domestic companies looking to expand internationally.

items.title_en: China Province & Washington State Trade and Investment Cooperation Forum
items.title_zh: 中国省与华盛顿州贸易投资合作论坛
items.summary_en: CCCWA hosted a major forum connecting Chinese provincial delegations with Washington State representatives.
items.summary_zh: CCCWA主办中美贸易投资合作论坛，搭建中国省级代表团与华盛顿州政商界之间的交流平台。
items.body_en:
On July 26, 2017, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) hosted one of its most significant events to date: the China Province and Washington State Trade and Investment Cooperation Forum (中国省与华盛顿州贸易投资合作论坛). The forum brought together high-level delegations from multiple Chinese provincial governments with Washington State business leaders, investment professionals, and government representatives to explore concrete opportunities for bilateral cooperation.

The event represented a key milestone in CCCWA's mission to facilitate cross-border trade and investment, demonstrating the organization's growing role as a bridge between regional actors on both sides of the Pacific.

## Delegates and Participants

The forum drew provincial delegations representing several of China's most economically active regions, each bringing specific investment priorities and sector interests. On the Washington State side, participants included business leaders from technology, real estate, agriculture, healthcare, and financial services — sectors in which the Pacific Northwest has both depth and global standing.

Government representatives from Washington State participated alongside private sector figures, signaling the official recognition of CCCWA's convening role and the broader significance of China-Washington economic ties to the state's economic development strategy.

## Discussion and Outcomes

Forum sessions focused on identifying specific areas of mutual interest for investment and trade development. Real estate and infrastructure development, technology and innovation, agricultural exports, and tourism were among the sectors explored. Participants discussed both the opportunities and the practical challenges of cross-border investment, including regulatory requirements, cultural differences, and due diligence practices.

One-on-one meetings between Chinese provincial representatives and Washington State businesses were arranged alongside the main forum sessions, allowing for targeted conversations that could lead to specific partnerships and transactions. CCCWA played a direct facilitation role, connecting parties based on aligned interests and providing bilingual support throughout the process.

## Significance for CCCWA

The forum demonstrated CCCWA's capacity to organize substantive, high-level engagements that go beyond networking to produce real economic opportunity. By hosting provincial delegations alongside Washington State counterparts, CCCWA positioned itself as an indispensable intermediary in the growing economic relationship between China's regions and the Pacific Northwest — a role the organization has continued to develop through subsequent forums and delegation visits.
items.body_zh:
2017年7月26日，华州中华总商会（CCCWA）主办了迄今为止最为重要的活动之一——中国省与华盛顿州贸易投资合作论坛。此次论坛汇聚了来自中国多个省级政府的高级别代表团，以及华盛顿州的商界领袖、投资专业人士与政府代表，共同探讨双边合作的切实机遇。

此次活动是华州中华总商会推动跨境贸易与投资使命进程中的一个重要里程碑，彰显了本会作为太平洋两岸区域合作桥梁这一角色的不断壮大。

## 代表团与参会嘉宾

论坛吸引了来自中国多个经济最为活跃地区的省级代表团，各代表团均带来了各自明确的投资重点与行业关注领域。华盛顿州方面的参会者则包括来自科技、房地产、农业、医疗保健及金融服务等领域的商界领袖——这些正是太平洋西北地区兼具深厚积累与全球地位的重点行业。

华盛顿州政府代表与私营部门人士共同出席，彰显了官方对华州中华总商会召集角色的认可，也表明中国与华盛顿州之间的经济联系对该州经济发展战略具有更为深远的意义。

## 讨论与成果

论坛各环节聚焦于确定投资与贸易发展领域中双方共同关注的具体方向，探讨的行业包括房地产与基础设施开发、科技创新、农产品出口及旅游业等。与会者就跨境投资的机遇与实际挑战展开了讨论，内容涉及监管要求、文化差异以及尽职调查实务等方面。

除主论坛环节外，主办方还安排了中国省级代表与华盛顿州企业之间的一对一会谈，使双方得以进行有针对性的交流，进而促成具体的合作与交易。华州中华总商会在整个过程中发挥了直接的牵线搭桥作用，根据双方利益契合点促成对接，并全程提供双语支持。

## 对华州中华总商会的意义

此次论坛充分展现了华州中华总商会组织高水准、内容扎实的交流活动的能力，其成果远超一般的人脉联谊，切实催生出真正的经济机遇。通过将中国省级代表团与华盛顿州各界代表汇聚一堂，华州中华总商会将自身定位为中国各地区与太平洋西北地区日益紧密的经济关系中不可或缺的中间桥梁——此后本会通过一系列后续论坛与代表团互访，持续深化和拓展着这一角色。

items.body_en:
China Provinces and Washington State Trade and Investment Cooperation Forum

To implement the consensus reached by the Chinese and American heads of state on the bilateral trade '100-Day Plan' and to further advance economic and trade cooperation between Chinese provinces and US states, the 'China Provinces and Washington State Trade and Investment Cooperation Forum' — hosted by China's Ministry of Commerce Bureau of Foreign Trade Development and the Washington State Department of Commerce, co-organized by the Washington State China Relations Council, and supported by China's Ministry of Commerce — was successfully held in Bellevue on July 20th. Over 100 attendees participated, including delegations from Chinese provincial and municipal governments, representatives of enterprises in key sectors of US-China cooperation, Washington State government representatives, Washington chamber of commerce representatives, and US business representatives.

Washington State Department of Commerce Director Brian Bonlender delivered opening remarks.

Washington State Lieutenant Governor Cyrus Habib gave remarks.

Washington State China Relations Council Chairman Andy Wilson gave remarks.

Sun Chenghai, Director-General of China's Ministry of Commerce Bureau of Foreign Trade Development, gave remarks. Director-General Sun noted that in recent years, Washington State was ranked by CNBC as one of the best US states for investment. China is Washington State's largest export market. Chinese enterprises have already invested in 112 projects in Washington State, totaling over $600 million and creating 1,300 jobs, with significant potential for future growth.

CCCWA member Zhang Ming, Chairman of MZE Zhang Ming Design Firm, spoke.

CCCWA member Holly Yang, Partner at Kidder Mathews, spoke.

CCCWA member Wang Yuping, Partner at Davis Wright Tremaine LLP, spoke.

CCCWA member Liu Qianjun, Chairwoman of GIYA, was photographed with Consul Yang Yihang of the Chinese Consulate-General in San Francisco.

Representatives from Washington's Snohomish County, Pierce County, Skagit County, the Port of Seattle, and UiEnergy spoke about the development advantages of their respective regions.

Representatives from China's Liaoning, Guangdong, and Hunan provinces, as well as representatives from JD.com, Boshen Industries, and other Chinese enterprises, also introduced the advantages of their regions and companies and sought cooperation with US partners.

items.body_en:
June 8th marked the one-year anniversary of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State, celebrated with a small reception at the ICBC Seattle business center. Over the past year, through the dedicated efforts of its leadership and members, the Chamber built a high-caliber platform for Chinese business exchange from the ground up, with remarkable results.

Founded in the fiercely competitive Seattle market, the Chamber received support from many Chinese enterprises, fully showcasing the strength of outstanding entrepreneurs. Well-known American firms such as Davis Wright Tremaine LLP and Deloitte also joined as members, expanding the Chamber's platform for exchange with local businesses and extending its influence across Greater Seattle. Seattle has also been a hotspot for Chinese enterprise investment in the US, and Chinese-invested companies saw smooth development over the past year. The Chamber's value lies in serving as a bridge for US-China development — mutually beneficial for both sides, building friendships through trade, and providing broad opportunities for exposure and information exchange. Through the several expert lecture series the Chamber has hosted, businesses across industries have had the chance to efficiently connect with and learn from many outstanding companies, bringing everyone new ideas and opportunities for shared growth.

items.title_en: CCCWA 'Seattle Lecture Series' Episode 4: New Opportunities in Real Estate Investment Across the US and in Seattle
items.title_zh: 华盛顿州中国总商会“西雅图大讲坛”第四期：美国各地和西雅图房地产投资的新机遇
items.body_en:
Background:

Home prices in 20 major U.S. cities have risen for the fifth consecutive month at an accelerating pace. Over the past two years, Seattle has emerged as a cloud computing hub, attracting a large number of IT and high-tech professionals. This influx has in turn fueled economic growth across multiple sectors in the region, including real estate, healthcare, commerce, tourism, education, and cultural exchange. Population growth inevitably translates into housing demand, and Seattle continues to lead the nation in home price appreciation. The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) has invited Zillow's Principal Economist to share professionally analyzed data and insights, helping the community stay informed about the latest trends in the local real estate market.

Background:

In the past two years, Seattle, as a cloud computing center, has attracted numerous IT and high-tech elites. It has become a driving force behind regional economic growth in areas such as real estate, healthcare, commerce, manufacturing, tourism, education, and cultural exchange.

The Principal Economist from Zillow, Mr. Aaron Terrazas, will share his outlook on the real estate industry in the United States and the Greater Seattle Area.

Speaker Introduction:

Mr. Aaron Terrazas is a Senior Principal Economist at Zillow. He holds a Bachelor's degree in International Diplomacy from Georgetown University and a Master's degree in Applied Economics (with a focus on Economic Forecasting) from Johns Hopkins University. He previously served as an economist at the U.S. Treasury Department's Office of Economic Policy. In 2014, he joined Zillow, the largest, most trusted, and most active real estate information platform in the United States, headquartered in Seattle.

Speaker:

Mr. Aaron Terrazas, Principal Economist from Zillow

Agenda Summary:

  • Sharing the latest trends in the U.S. real estate market nationwide, with a focus on the Greater Seattle area, including population distribution, market trends, and price appreciation rates for single-family homes, townhomes, and condominiums.

  • Brief introduction to the various features and information available on the Zillow platform.

  • Guidance on how to use the platform from China to facilitate investment in the U.S. real estate market.

Agenda:

  • Information regarding the real estate market nationwide, with a focus on the Greater Seattle area: geography, market trends, price appreciation rates for single-family homes, multi-family properties, condos, etc.

  • Introduction of Zillow website features: how to leverage the platform to obtain sufficient information.

  • Discussion on Zillow's website specifically for the Chinese market.

Time:

Thursday, May 25, 2017
2:00 PM – 3:00 PM PDT

Venue:

Zillow Conference Room
Floor 31, 1301 2nd AVE
Seattle, WA 98101

Free Registration Link (or click "Read More" at the bottom of the article):

https://www.eventbrite.com/e/34130708869?from=timeline&isappinstalled=0

items.body_en:
Lecture title: New opportunities for Seattle startups to attract talent and capital through the entrepreneur visa.

Guest speakers: Attorney Cai Qing and Attorney Charlie Cai of Cai & Cai Law Office. Attorney Cai Qing came to the US to study in 1985 and graduated from UC Berkeley School of Law (J.D.). She is licensed to practice law in both Washington State and China, focusing on cross-border US-China investment, corporate, real estate, and business transactions. Attorney Charlie Cai graduated from Emory University School of Law (J.D.) and is licensed in both Washington State and New York, focusing on work and investment immigration visas (H1-B, L1, EB1, EB5, E visas). Both attorneys also serve as advisors to the US-China Innovation Center, which actively promotes collaboration between innovation platforms in the two countries.
