items.body_en:
In 2017, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State launched its 'Seattle Lecture Series.' Episode 1: experts break down recent hot topics — 1. 2018 H1B work visas: what jobs qualify for H1B, when to start looking for an employer, how to contact an attorney, what's changed under new regulations, and how to prepare a backup plan if not selected in the lottery. 2. Investment immigration: increases in the required investment amount — when and by how much, changes to Targeted Employment Area (TEA) regional center rules, and the impact on green card applications already submitted. 3. The investor/entrepreneur 'EB6' visa: how it differs from EB5 investment immigration and from the L1A intracompany executive transfer visa.

Presented by: Cao Xiaohe Law Office.
items.body_zh: 华盛顿州中国总商会2017推出“西雅图大讲坛”系列专题讲座。 第一期：专业人士为大家解析近期的热点：2018 H1B工作签证: 什么工作可以申请H1B,什么时候开始找雇主, 联系律师, 新规定在哪些方面有变化,如何准备抽不上的应对方法2.投资移民：金额的增加：什么时候增加，增加多少,区域中心TEA 的规定有什么变化对已经递交的绿卡申请的影响 3.投资者/创业者签证 “EB6”: 和EB5投资移民的差别,和L1A跨国高管的差别 主讲单位: 曹霄鹤律师事务所

items.body_en:
The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) successfully held its Chinese Lunar New Year gala dinner at the Grand Hyatt Seattle, bringing together over 200 representatives from across Washington State.

Microsoft Executive Vice President Harry Shum delivered a keynote titled 'AI for Everyone,' sharing the importance of artificial intelligence to human life, walking attendees through current AI research and future directions, and showcasing Microsoft's ongoing efforts around AI. In the near future, computer vision and hearing will surpass human capability, and chatbots will have great promise in both daily life and enterprise settings. Harry also examined in depth the role AI plays between humans and computers, concluding that AI innovation will further unlock human curiosity, creativity, and humanistic care. As Harry put it: 'AI isn't just another step forward in the digital age — it's the ultimate goal people imagined long before the first computer ever existed.'

Other distinguished guests who spoke included Washington State Department of Commerce Director Brian Bonlender, Seattle Deputy Mayor Hyeok Kim, Richard Lazaro, head of the Seattle metro region for the U.S. Senate, former Bellevue Mayor and current councilmember Conrad Lee, and Andy Wilson representing the Washington State China Relations Council.

Guzheng performer Wang Jing brought beautiful music to the evening. Well-known Chinese-American comedian Uncle Cuige also performed, keeping the audience laughing throughout.

The gala received generous support from the Washington State China Relations Council (WSCRC), the Washington State Hong Kong Chamber of Commerce, the Seattle Entrepreneurs' Association, and numerous Chinese-invested enterprises in the US.

由美国华盛顿州中国总商会（CCCWA）主办的庆祝中国农历新年春节晚宴在西雅图Grand Hyatt Seattle酒店圆满举行，200多位华州代表共聚一堂

items.title_en: CCCWA is now seeking new members!
items.title_zh: 华盛顿州中国总商会开放会员招募
items.body_en:
The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) is a non-profit organization voluntarily initiated by Chinese-funded enterprises based in Washington State. It aims to promote investment and trade cooperation between China and Washington State, and to support and facilitate more Chinese enterprises in their investments in the United States. Its council member companies span sectors including finance, telecommunications, technology, aviation, real estate, and biomedicine. After several months of preparation, the Chamber has now officially opened its membership recruitment to the public.

Membership is open to chambers of commerce, organizations, enterprises, and individuals both within the United States and overseas. The recruitment period is scheduled from August 8 to September 30. Due to limited registered member slots, the recruitment may end earlier than scheduled. Companies, enterprises, and individuals interested in joining are invited to complete the membership application form through our WeChat official account.

After several months of intensive preparation, the Chamber has finally opened its official membership recruitment. Membership is open to chambers of commerce, associations, organizations, enterprises, and individuals both domestically and internationally. The recruitment period runs from August 8 to September 30. Due to the cap on registered members, the recruitment drive may conclude early.

Benefits for Chamber members include, but are not limited to:

• Assistance with invitation letters, itinerary design, arrangements, and local hospitality for overseas members visiting Washington State;

• Regular communication with the Washington State government to keep members informed of policies and incentives related to foreign investment and business;

• Periodic seminars and workshops in various fields such as finance, law, taxation, business operations, human resources, immigration law, visas, and team management;

• Organization of business matching events, including opportunities for Washington State enterprises to invest in China and for Chinese enterprises to invest in the U.S.;

• Regular networking events and annual meetings;

• Assistance with passport and visa-related matters;

• And more.

Companies, enterprises, and individuals interested in joining are kindly requested to complete the membership application form through our WeChat official account.
items.body_zh:
华盛顿州中国总商会是由在华盛顿州的中资企业自愿发起组成的非营利性组织，旨在促进中国和美国华盛顿州投资贸易合作，支持和帮助更多的中资企业对美投资。其理事会成员单位涵盖了金融，通讯，科技，航空，地产以及生物医药等领域。经过几个月的筹备，总商会终于开放了对外正式招募成员。

会员招募面向美国本土以及海外各商会，组织，企业以及个人。本次招募计划从8月8日开始到9月30日结束。由于注册会员的名额限制，招募活动有可能提前结束。有意向加入的公司，企业以及个人，请进入我们的微信公众平台完成入会申请表格。

经过几个月的紧张筹备，总商会终于开放了对外正式招募成员。会员招募面向美国本土以及海外各商会、协会、组织、企业以及个人，本次招募计划从8月8号开始到9月30号结束。由于注册会员的名额限制，招募活动有可能提前结束。


商会成员单位在加入商会后可获得的福利包括但不限于：

• 商会将协助海外会员办理来华州访问交流的邀请、行程设计、安排和当地接待；
• 商会会定期与华盛顿州政府沟通，帮助成员了解华州吸引外资、外商的有关政策及优惠；
• 商会将不定期举办金融、法律、税务、公司运营、人力资源、移民法、签证、团队管理等不同领域的讲座；
• 商会将举办华州的企业去华投资、中资企业来美投资等走出去寻找商机、企业配对等活动；
• 商会将定期举办Networking活动、年会；
• 商会将协助会员办理护照、签证等事务；
• 其他
 

有意向加入的公司，企业及个人，请进入我们的微信公众号完成入会申请表格。

items.title_en: CCCWA Opening Ceremony
items.title_zh: 华盛顿州中国总商会开幕典礼
items.body_en:
June 8, 2016, coinciding with the Dragon Boat Festival in China, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) held its inaugural ceremony in Seattle.

The CCCWA is a non-profit organization voluntarily initiated by a group of Chinese-funded enterprises based in Washington State. Its founding council member companies span industries including finance, telecommunications, technology, aviation, real estate, and healthcare and pharmaceuticals. The chamber's establishment took over three months of preparation and received strong support from the very beginning from the Chinese Consulate General in San Francisco, the Washington State government, and the municipal governments of Seattle, Bellevue, and Tacoma. It also garnered assistance and positive responses from local friendly chambers of commerce and businesses.

On the evening of the inaugural ceremony, Consul General Luo Linquan of the Chinese Consulate General in San Francisco, Mr. Brian Bonlender, Director of the Washington State Department of Commerce, Seattle Mayor Ed Murray, Tacoma Mayor Marilyn Strickland, former U.S. Ambassador to China Gary Locke, and former Bellevue Mayor and current City Councilmember Conrad Lee all attended the event and delivered congratulatory speeches. In his address, Consul General Luo Linquan noted that the establishment of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State carries great significance, as it will create a new platform for exchange among Chinese enterprises, the Chinese community, and local stakeholders in Washington State. Consul General Luo also offered his expectations for the Chamber's future development, encouraging it to leverage its unique strengths by providing high-quality and efficient services and organizing diverse activities to promote mutually beneficial cooperation between Chinese and American businesses.

Remarks by Consul General Luo Linquan

Ms. Zhou Honghua, Chairperson of the CCCWA, also stated that following the establishment of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State, it will maximize the strengths of its members while actively collaborating with other organizations to host a variety of activities that serve its member companies and promote bilateral trade and investment.

Remarks by Ms. Zhou Honghua

Washington State Commerce Director, the Mayor of Seattle, Mr. Gary Locke, and other distinguished guests also extended their congratulations on the establishment of the Chamber.

Remarks by Mr. Gary Locke

Director Brian Bonlender greeted everyone in fluent Chinese and shared updates on the various areas of business cooperation between Washington State and China.

Remarks by Mr. Bonlender

Mayor Murray also shared with the audience his many experiences from his recently concluded trip to China in May. He offered his outlook on the tremendous potential for future cooperation between Seattle and China that the trip had revealed, and also announced a number of specific projects and initiatives. All those present extended their heartfelt best wishes for the Chamber's future development.

Remarks by Mayor Murray

The evening's event was also attended by representatives from local friendly chambers of commerce and various business leaders. They gathered together to celebrate this new development in the local Chinese community, while also deepening mutual understanding and friendship. Following the inaugural ceremony, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State plans to organize a series of cross-border and local events to effectively serve the interests of its members, strengthen interaction with the local community, and contribute to the development of Chinese-funded enterprises in Washington State as well as bilateral economic exchanges between the two countries.
items.body_zh:
2016年6月8日，适逢中国时间端午佳节，华盛顿州中国总商会

(Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State, 即CCCWA) 在西雅图举行了成立仪式。


华盛顿州中国总商会是由一批位于华盛顿州的中资企业自愿发起成立的非营利组织，创始理事会成员单位包括金融、通讯、科技、航空地产和医疗制药等领域。商会筹备历时三个多月，从开始即得到了来自旧金山总领馆，华盛顿州政府以及西雅图、贝尔维尤和塔科马市政府的大力支持，并得到了本地各友好商会、企业的帮助和响应。

成立仪式活动当晚，中国驻美国旧金山总领馆罗林泉总领事，华盛顿州商务厅厅长Brian Bonlender先生，西雅图市市长穆雷先生，塔科马市长史蒂克兰德女士，美国前驻华大使骆家辉先生，以及贝尔维尤前华人市长、现任议员李瑞麟先生都前来出席并致辞祝贺。 罗林泉总领事在致辞中指出，华盛顿州中国商会成立具有非常重要的意义，将为在华州的广大中国企业、华人，以及当地各界人士搭建一个新的交流平台。罗总领事同时对商会的工作发展提出了希望，指导商会发挥自身的优势，通过提供优质高效的服务，举办形式多样的活动，促进两国企业互利合作。

罗林泉总领事致辞

总商会主席周红华女士也表示，华州中国总商会成立以后，将最大限度地发挥会员自身长处，同时积极与其他机构进行合作，举办各种服务于会员单位、促进两地商贸投资的活动。

周红华女士致辞

华州商务厅长、西雅图市长和骆家辉先生等也都对协会的成立表达了的祝贺。

骆家辉先生致辞

厅长Brian Bonlender用熟练的中文和大家问好，并介绍了华州和中国在商务领域的多方面合作进展。

Bonlender先生致辞

穆雷市长更是和大家分享了5月份刚刚结束的中国之行的诸多体会，展望了这次行程所展现出的未来西雅图和中国巨大的合作潜力，也公布了很多具体项目和措施。大家都对协会未来的发展表示了衷心的祝福。

穆雷市长致辞

活动当晚到场的还包括本地友好商会、各企业领导代表，大家欢聚一堂，共庆这一本地华人社区新发展的同时，也加深了彼此的了解和友谊。成立仪式后，华州中国总商会计划筹备一系列跨境、本地活动，切实服务会员利益，加强和本地社区的互动，为中资企业在华州的发展和两国双边经济往来贡献力量。
